name: Gobball Amulet
description: Watch out ladies, it seems this thing chews everything it comes across! Lacy shawls, woolly sweaters, and even leather clavicle-warmers have all been known to get a nibbling. Or is it all just tall talk?

name: Bouze Lite Yeah's Ring
description: This ring once belonged to the renowned Bouze Lite Yeah, the savior of the ancient World. His favorite sentence was about some Inn or another called the "Finity and Beyond."

name: Gobboots
description: With these boots, you no longer have to worry about stepping in Gobball dung. The smell will be exactly the same, either way.

name: Gobball Cape
description: This cloak was made from the remains of a Gobball's dinner. Yes, you read right. Sometimes even Gobballs don't clear their plates.

name: Gobball Belt
description: This puffy and soft belt is a real temptation... Less secure adventurers benefit from the extra padding to make others believe they're better equipped than they are.

name: Gobball Headgear
description: Some say that the two horns on this hat can predict how your love life will turn out. That's one good reason to watch where you're sitting!

name: Gobbhammer
description: This hammer doesn't just like to smash things, it likes to bite them, too. And, if you believe that, you must need your head looking at...

name: Tofu Amulet
description: If you manage to get this amulet around your waist you will unleash its true powers.

name: Tofu Ring
description: The height of class for the Tofoones. But are you a Tofoone though?

name: Tofu Sword
description: It is rumored that this sword was forged by a tofu! He must have been very talented indeed! Almost as talented as you are gullible, in fact...

name: Tofu Cloak
description: Light, useful, and a soft yellow... Tofu feathers exist for the sole purpose of making this cloak!

name: Tofu Belt
description: This belt is scarily light. It seems anything hidden behind it becomes weightless...

name: Helmetofu
description: This Tofu skull becomes you perfectly. Too bad you didn’t remove the eyes, it looks a little too cheeky...

name: Tofu Boots
description: Mad races across spring fields, stampeding like a thousand rutting Tofus! It's good not to be afraid of looking silly.

name: Twiggy Epaulettes
description: Made from 100% recyclable materials, these epaulettes won't protect you, but at least you'll have a clear conscience.

name: Gobbshield
description: This shield is so light you sometimes forget it's there to protect you! Though maybe that's because it's not doing such a great job of it...

name: Gobblette Wand
description: This is an improved version of the Shepherd's Staff. This wand now has even more ways of driving your flock to chop up your enemies.

name: Tofu Epaulettes
description: If you see Tofus running after you when you're wearing these epaulettes, fear not! They just think you're one of them!

name: Tofu Shield
description: Ah, this shield has clearly already taken one victim...

name: Little Tofu Hand
description: This small, pointy clock hand was carved in Tofu bone. Please don't confuse it with actual Tofu on the Bone, which is a culinary specialty.

name: Royal Piwi Hat
description: Despite its lightness, this hat won't be able to do anything for you if you have a big head. Quite the opposite, in fact.

name: Scythe
description: This scythe's handle is about as sturdy as a piece of paper. You should just about manage to harvest some Wheat with it.

name: Pick
description: Enutrof expressions have a unique simplicity... for example 'Make sure you bring a pick with you when you go digging.' Simple but true. Oh so true.

name: Red Piwat
description: Piwis were not only hurt, they were killed to make this human-scale representation of a Piwi's noggin.

name: Purple Piwat
description: Piwis were not only hurt, they were killed to make this human-scale representation of a Piwi's noggin.

name: Green Piwat
description: Piwis were not only hurt, they were killed to make this human-scale representation of a Piwi's noggin.

name: Red Capiwin
description: This cloak is light, very light. In fact, it weighs about the same as a Piwi brain!

name: Purple Capiwin
description: This cloak is light, very light. In fact, it weighs about the same as a Piwi brain!

name: Green Capiwin
description: This cloak is light, very light. In fact, it weighs about the same as a Piwi brain!

name: Red Piwi Belt
description: This belt was made with love. The tuft of plumes is just to add a touch of glamour.

name: Purple Piwi Belt
description: This belt was made with love. The tuft of plumes is just to add a touch of glamour.

name: Green Piwi Belt
description: This belt was made with love. The tuft of plumes is just to add a touch of glamour.

name: Red Piwi Claw Slippers
description: These Piwi claws have somehow been mysteriously expanded to fit your feet. Now, you can sit on branches, if they'll hold your weight.

name: Purple Piwi Claw Slippers
description: These Piwi claws have somehow been mysteriously expanded to fit your feet. Now, you can sit on branches, if they'll hold your weight.

name: Green Piwi Claw Slippers
description: These Piwi claws have somehow been mysteriously expanded to fit your feet. Now, you can sit on branches, if they'll hold your weight.

name: Popourri Hat
description: Its woodland scent follows you everywhere. It's very practical for covering up that wild odor certain Sadidas give off!

name: The Maimpa
description: Maimpa was an Ecaflip who wasn't afraid of heights... he thought he'd always land on his feet. One day, he landed on a starving Trool...

name: Wooden Hatchet
description: About as sharp as a sack of wet mice, but just as heavy.

name: Exeter Rats
description: We could go on and on about these epaulettes…

name: Twiggy Club
description: It looks like an old piece of wood picked up off the forest floor, but it’s strong enough for you to defend yourself with.

name: Mad Hammer
description: Who would have thought that a Tofu trapped in his own guano could make such a strong hammer? Who would have thought it could make a hammer at all?

name: Perryclees Sword
description: Perryclees, the sword swallower, made this sword to keep his breath fresh at all times. Unfortunately, he didn't live long enough to see if it worked.

name: Smoothitch O'Bal
description: This amulet is, in fact, a piece of candy. Before you go putting it in your mouth, though, you might like to know that it was made by being rolled under the armpits of 36 generations of female Bworks in heat.

name: The Gougnole
description: The Gougnole is made from the moon stone, which had been soaking in a barrel of root beer for 5000 years. As a result, it's awfully powerful.

name: Twiggy Amulet
description: This amulet, made exclusively of wood, is prized by lumberjacks who think it can do things it couldn’t possibly do.

name: Shrink Ring
description: This ring makes the finger wearing it much smaller and daintier.

name: Agilish Ring
description: Amaknian collectors would and do kill for this ring, though it isn’t worth a brass farthing.

name: War Chief Axe
description: Wield this axe and you will immediately feel like a true 'leader of troops'. If opinion on this is divided, let it fall upon the heads of the unruly. At least you'll be the only one left with any say.

name: Hidsad Bow
description: The man who created this bow, a certain Marc Hidsad, never really knew how to use it. He usually hurt himself just as much as his enemies.

name: Cape Huccino
description: This cape was made with just one goal in mind: It had to be able to keep its owner awake for a few days running.

name: Gobbcards
description: To guarantee a more comfortable grip, the edges of these cards have been covered with Gobball wool. It's sweet, but unbelievably smelly.

name: Loyalty Cards
description: The female Ecaflips use these cards to avenge the infidelity of their partner... by cutting off a body part...  the hands, I’m sure.

name: Lass Sword
description: Once again you failed to control your urge… Another sword you’ll never use! Stop saying that this is the last: No one believes you!

name: Nickelbow
description: Now that you have it, it’s the most important thing in your life. Your enemies will not hesitate to obey their master - now you call the shots...

name: Twiggy Cards
description: Beautiful cards engraved in wood, enough to make a Tofu tremble in fear!

name: Shepherd's Staff
description: With its gobball-shaped pommel, this staff really commands respect. When hit someone with it, the only noise to break the awe-struck silence will be an "ow"!

name: Inn Shield
description: This shield, made from a tavern sign, will make sure you don't get any headaches, but that's about it.

name: Authentic Bowisse Boots
description: These boots (or their odor, at least) were inspired by a famous model. Put them on and you'll feel so sure of yourself that you'll actually be faster and more resistant than before.

name: The Bumper
description: Not to be confused with the bra of the same name from the "Lovely Chassis" series by Jean-Trool Grospied.

name: Capeoeira
description: This cloak is so liquid and light it will hang on to your back through all your Chackie Jan moments

name: Daudgee
description: The Daudgee is made from Ouginak remains and various other refuse. Worn by Gourlo the Terrible for a long time, the Daudgee is the image of desolation.

name: Mine Helmet
description: For miners who are hungry for ore.

name: The Jouik Krampe
description: This magnificent leather mask once belonged to Jouik Krampe, cousin of Zeurg. They were both fond of tight leather clothes.

name: Twiggy Belt
description: If you have the soul of a lumberjack and you love big knots, this belt’s for you. It may well be your undoing, however.

name: Swocks
description: These epaulettes will awaken the sleeping beast inside of you.

name: Fisherman's Waders
description: Boots made for fishermen who have beautiful legs and know it.

name: Twiggy Boots
description: With these boots round your toes, you'll feel...  like you have your toes in boots.

name: Straw Hat
description: Turned upside down, this straw hat can be used as a fruit basket or a container for begging in the street. Isn't modern technology wonderful?

name: Raysting Hand
description: This clock hand can burrow its own way into your enemy's orifices.

name: Thettle Ring
description: Thistle and Nettle fibers woven together, and what an effect! Even the most demanding of Osas will love it!

name: Swiffer Wand
description: This wand is behind the emancipation of Eniripsa housewives. It's excellent for getting rid of both monsters and dust. Practical, no?

name: Gobball Breastplate
description: It's soft, it's new, and it’s clean... Oh sorry, it's not clean.

name: Gobball Epaulettes
description: The first woolen shoulder pads that can kill...  annihilation by odor, that is.

name: Tofu Breastplate
description: Have you ever been told that yellow suits you? Yes? Amazing...

name: Kamailles' Coat
description: With this armor on your back, you're safe from Enutrofs. They’re afraid of turtles, they are!

properties.name: NOT_RECYCLABLE
properties.description: Non-recyclable (cannot be placed in a crusher)

name: Conquered Raziel
description: The flood seems to have been hugely beneficial to this blessed sword, which has drawn a new and vengeful power from the water.

name: King of Borins' Bow
description: This unconventional bow was designed specifically for the self-proclaimed king of a village of peasants, who loved showing off by firing two arrows simultaneously.

name: Truffle Shovel
description: The Truffle Shovel will make the people around you laugh. At you, though, not with you.

name: Starry Shield
description: Would you look at that! This huge star has taken a liking to your shield!

name: Desire O'Ball Cloak
description: This cloak is made of red beard hair… it is quite unique. Animated by extraordinarily powerful magic that renders it all but living, it adores playing practical jokes on the unfortunate soul who puts it on.

name: Boowolf String
description: Yes, Boowolwes also wear Strings, so what? Everyone is entitled to their share of femininity!

name: Sangroku's Belt
description: When Sangroku had eaten too many magic beans, he tied this belt hard around his waist to plug the winds of panic for which he was famous.

name: Gobbsword
description: A sword made from solidified Gobball grime. In other words, a formidable weapon.

name: A La Cards
description: These cards allow you to choose exactly which parts of your enemy you'd like to have for dinner.

name: Tofu Staff
description: It would have been wise to make sure the egg was empty before making this weapon...

name: Tofu Wand
description: This wand will go perfectly with all the brightly-colored feathery underwear you own. Oh don’t act all innocent!

name: Tofu Shovel
description: The process that made this Tofu beak flat remains a secret. All we can tell you is that we had a lot of help from Mama Bworks.

name: Bloo Boots
description: When you wear these boots, the earth will burn in your tracks. Your enemies too.

name: The Beeeelt
description: Clearly, the creator of this belt had a funny way of communicating with his flock.

name: The Gap
description: An old, worn cloak off a dead man. A lucky omen no doubt.

name: The Masked Sombrero
description: An essential accessory for somber heroes everywhere. Too bad for you, it's also the mark of sober heroes everywhere.

name: Vestorn
description: No, this vest didn't belong to an adventurer out to conquer the Vild Vest. It earned this nickname by getting torn in the wash. Repeatedly.

name: The Blinder
description: You're probably wondering why they have this name. Raise your shoulders and your question will be answered.

name: The Country
description: Aaaah! You've finally decided to let him slip his ring over your finger!

name: Twiggy Headband
description: A headband made of wood, yeah, so what? What’s the problem?

name: Piwi Dagger
description: Is this the type of knife you'll want to keep by your side forever, or just for a day?

name: Piwi Axe
description: An axe for chopping off the head of your enemy, provided your enemy is a tiny, wimpy little monster.

name: Piwi Wand
description: Well, what? Look at it. It's a wand. It's not rocket science!

name: Piwi Hammer
description: Those who don’t like violence can use it to hammer nails. Those who love violence will use it to hammer nails into the skulls of their opponents.

name: Piwi Sword
description: Too bad you’re terrible with a sword...

name: Piwi Hand
description: This clock hand will give your opponents the rope to hang themselves with...

name: Pandawan Kimono
description: We told you it wouldn't be the last…

name: Pandawan Hat
description: This must be the hat Magalouf was talking about in his rhyme 'eenie meenie hatty ho.' This information is completely useless. Much like yourself.

name: Pandawan Belt
description: This is the famous belt that Pandawans tend to take off when they’ve drunk too much. Let's just say they don't wear it too often.

name: Cutlass
description: This cutlass is actually a piece of Crackler that was found on the floor and decorated with rock art to make it appear more manly.

name: Billhook
description: A tool cleverly designed to...  Cut. Yes, but with two blades, for greater accuracy and closeness!

name: Fishing Rod
description: Do they bite? Not a bite? Ohh! I got a Chefish!

name: The Fire of Love
description: Even if the flame doesn’t warm your lonely heart, it will let you see in the dark.

properties.name: TREASURE
properties.description: Treasure Item (special interface)

name: Black Crow's Boots
description: These boots are in impeccable condition. It's not surprising for someone who did most of his traveling by air!

name: Black Crow's Ring
description: The best way to keep track of a bird is to ring it!

name: Black Crow's Cloak
description: A needle, some thread and a few feathers taken from a decomposing Crobak... and now you have one of the most fashionable capes in the World of Twelve!

name: Croboots
description: These Croboots emit a Crow squawk with every step you take. You can make the enemy flee just by warning them of your imminent arrival.

name: Crobak Breastplate
description: A feathery thing that you can take great pleasure in showing off in the most squalid tavern in town.

name: Crobelt
description: This belt is supposed to improve back trouble. Or is that the other way round? You won't know until you try it on!

name: Wooden Fishing Rod
description: A wooden rod is better than a bamboo one because it fishes further... You can do even better, though!

name: Coonan Cutlass
description: Tiger! Upper Cutlass!

name: Broocefore Scythe
description: Nice to scythe you, to scythe you nice! This scythe will allow you to collect A FEW more grains per harvest.

name: Lumberjack Hatchet
description: Your last one was better at crushing than cutting, and this one's better at smashing than crushing...

name: Goldigger's Pick
description: Mine, pick, then, as you carry the fruits of your labor home, sing: "Hi-ho, hi-ho, it's home from work we go!"

name: Esk Billhook
description: It is claimed that Getafiks used this billhook to harvest his own nasal hair. No one knows what he did with it...

name: Beltrool
description: Trool slayers normally wear their belts as a trophy. Well, the biggest ones do.

name: Trool Scalp
description: With this scalp on your head, you're going to have so much fun! You might even manage to seduce a female Trool...

name: Trool Boots
description: Let's hope these boots are as solid as they are smelly...

name: Boowolf Breastplate
description: Since this breastplate arrived on the market, a new fighting technique has been seen on the battlefield. It's known as 'tufting.'

name: Royal Piwi Amulet
description: Normally, you wear the crown on your head. But it looks like you've decided to make a bold fashion statement, once again...

name: Poke Cards
description: In the past, these cards were part of a much loved game in the World of Twelve. Nowadays, they're fearful weapons.

name: Royal Gobbsword
description: This sword absolutely stinks, but try not to let it show! It's not a great idea to tell a Royal Gobball he smells...

name: Royal Gobbhammer
description: You'd never have believed it, but it hurts as bad as it smells! What power!

name: Royal Gobbshield
description: Instead of fighting like a prince, why not defend yourself like a king?

name: Royal Gobball Amulet
description: Smelly, but royal, this amulet will make your regal friends very jealous.

name: Kawfy Wand
description: You know, like the drink, but not spelled the same.

name: Royal Tofu Boots
description: These boots are made by sticking royal feathers to royal guano. Very classy.

name: Barnacle Getas
description: In certain areas of the world, Barnacle Getas are thrown down to provoke duels.

name: The Resilient
description: This magnificent belt will make you look super sharp. Unless you're a Iop, of course.

name: Kama Belt
description: Anyone ever told you that you've got a heart of gold?

properties.name: NOT_RECYCLABLE
properties.description: Non-recyclable (cannot be placed in a crusher)

name: Twiggy Cloak
description: This cloak is ideal for learning to skateboard.

name: Capsule Cloak
description: A certain Mulba used this item to carry heavy items with her on her long, difficult quest to find the Seven Crystal Hens which fell from the stars.

name: Royal Capiwin
description: Now you've been royally tufted, all you have to do is convince the other Piwis to go and die alone.

name: Dora Bora
description: This headgear was very fashionable in days gone by, but these days you'll just look like a dinosaur wearing it.

properties.name: NOT_RECYCLABLE
properties.description: Non-recyclable (cannot be placed in a crusher)

name: Kama Hat
description: Now you can go to the bank and play at...  Kama kama kama kama kama chameleons!

properties.name: NOT_RECYCLABLE
properties.description: Non-recyclable (cannot be placed in a crusher)

name: Yamato's Rope
description: Yamato's Rope has made more than one monster's heart beat a little faster. A finely tuned weapon, it can direct arrows to even the most well-hidden targets.

name: Yorm Amulet
description: Your new amulet is so fat that when you put it on, you're in the basement surrounded by shards of wood.

name: Hour Wand
description: Made by the Eniripsa, Mie Dopan, this wand is able to turn back time to prevent fights. It normally ends up shoved in some demon's eye.

name: Amufafah
description: Wearers usually find this necklace really irritating, thanks to its decorative moustaches which tend to tickle the chest.

name: Strange Wand
description: Given its limited capabilities, you'd probably be better off using this wand as a back scratcher.

name: Bread Wand
description: Just because it was cooked in a bread oven, that doesn't mean this wand's edible. The lingering odor of baking powder will fool the hungriest Iops, though.

name: Kanniball Staff
description: Far from its Caniball, this exotic staff can feel quite homesick. That's why it's advisable to fight facing the sea, underneath a palm tree, to get the best out of it.

name: Ecalisor
description: A long time ago, King Allister gave this ring to Isidor, a smart cat, renowned for his incomparable agility.

name: Kings' Staff
description: Don't be fooled by its simplistic appearance: this staff has already put more than one herd of Gobballs in its place.

name: Intkisser Club
description: This weapon's owners can be easily recognized by their typical North Amakna accent and their battle cry, "Pow! Right in't Kisser!"

name: Dafturkey Club
description: This weapon has the power to make you look a fool. Don't say we didn't warn you!

name: Royal Gobball Epaulettes
description: These could be quite classy, if only the nauseating odor they give off didn't make you want to vomit.

name: Lidd Ihl
description: The collar of this particularly supple breastplate expands to let its owner put it on more easily.

name: The Astro
description: If you feel you're a superhero at heart, this axe is made for you. All you need now is an assortment of colored armor.

name: Militiaman Eater
description: This axe doesn't really eat militiamen. It does reduce them to mush though, which gives the impression that they've been chewed.

name: Boulgourde of the Glades
description: An axe which used to belong to Brouce Boulgoure, the famous lumberjack. This weapon allowed him to defend himself when he went out to chop down whole forests at night.

name: Ibo-Nanga Mace
description: If you listen closely, you might notice that this mace is permanently whistling a little tune that gets stuck in your head.

name: Outar Hammer
description: Outar Great Bwork ordered these fearsome hammers from a village of Xelors with the promise of sparing the townspeople if the hammers were well made. When he received the hammers, he destroyed the village. He needed to try his new weapons after all.

name: Twiggy Daggers
description: These aren't the best daggers in the World. They're certainly not the stuff of legends.

name: Penn Knives
description: These superb daggers used to belong to Penn the Amaknian scribe. He used them to engrave his stone notebooks.

name: Feti Daggers
description: Don't worry about where these daggers came from, or the fact that their handles seem to be a bit "slippery"!

name: The Goultard
description: The Goultard was soaked in a Dragon Pig's blood. Any hero who can bear the stench given off by the sword will have earnt the right to use it in battle.

name: Mishmashovel
description: With this shovel, you won't just be able weed your own daisies, you can make sure your enemies push up theirs as well.

name: Munster Shovel
description: A good shovel from the east. Its made from Moogrr milk, which explains its rather delicate perfume.

name: Mechba Shovel
description: This shovel isn't just used by Enutrofs to harvest fruit from their trees, but also as a formidable weapon.

name: Adventurer Hat
description: Aside from making the ladies run away, this hat is mostly only good against rain.

name: Kapow Helmet
description: This helmet is as light as a feather. All you have to do is wait for the wind to get up to turn your dreams of flying into reality... Crash Bang Wallop *stars*... Maybe not.

name: Royal Tofu Helmet
description: This helmet doesn't fit your small head at all. Or even a Iop's, come to think of it!

name: Royal Gobball Helmet
description: Try not to jump in head first or you might end up stuck in a branch or, even worse, with a load of dead Piwis skewered on your helmet.

name: Adventurer Boots
description: Very basic boots which are ideal for young adventurers just setting off on their journey.

name: Royal Gobball Boots
description: They shine; they exude strength; these boots are, in every way, royal.

name: Adventurer Cloak
description: Classy, but not very useful. This cape will still have a knockout effect on young warriors.

name: Royal Tofu Cloak
description: Less fur than the Tofu cloak, but ten times silkier. That's Royalty for you!

name: Royal Gobball Cape
description: This cloak, worn by his great Royal Gobball Associate, is both incredibly stylish and incredibly powerful.

name: Adventurer Belt
description: A little belt for budding adventurers.

name: Kapow Thongs
description: Hitting with your bare hands is overrated. Awkkkkkk ooooff cr-r-a-a-ck clunk-eth.

name: Royal Tofu Belt
description: For once, you've got your hands on a really classy belt. It even has an integrated seed dispenser.

name: Royal Tofu Epaulettes
description: All we can say about these epaulettes is that they'll make you look more like a crowd entertainer than a brave warrior.

name: Kapow Breastplate
description: A lightly perfumed breastplate which is wonderfully attractive to hungry Gobballs in the area.

name: Royal Gobball Breastplate
description: At first glance, there's nothing royal about this breastplate. In fact, it's even mangier and dirtier than the rest. That must be proof of the years of wisdom acquired by the Royal Gobball.

name: Adventure Ring
description: This is a lovely little ring for beginners and which will be cherished by kids and Ecaflips alike.

name: Adventure Amulet
description: Not very classy, not very useful, but nice when you have the set.

name: Royal Piwi Slippers
description: The Royal Piwi has rather fat ankles, so these slippers make comfortable boots for tired feet.

name: Royal Piwi Belt
description: This belt is much more than a pile of feathers. It's a pile of royal feathers!

name: Kapow Ring
description:
"One ring, biff kapow. Two rings, biff bang kablooey!"
Nostralanus - Thoughts

name: Kapowmulet
description: The Kapowmulet? There's nothing better for pow whap thwack biff bap bap zwapp sploosh klonk blurp ker-plopping all day long!

name: Kapow Belt
description: This belt does everything. Well, almost. Kapow sock whack!

name: Justice Epaulettes
description: Thanks to these epaulettes, you can spread justice to the impoverished. Or you can become a power-thirsty lunatic with his own selfish ideas about justice.

name: Justice Breastplate
description: Before you wear this armor, there is one condition: you have to be able to say "Sue shooed Shushus by the seashore" without getting your tongue twisted.

name: Banana Billhook
description: This Billhook was not created on a banana boat. Nor was it made yesterday!

name: Class Amulet
description: Giving you some class is what this amulet does best! And it doesn't do much else!

name: Upper Cutlass
description: This cutlass is based on the one used by Coonan the Beastbarian.

name: Psilo Scythe
description: Equipping this tool/weapon can lead to disturbing hallucinations, although some find it very pleasant and eye-opening.

name: Gelano
description: Gettin' jiggly wit it!

properties.name: EXCLUSIVE_EQUIPMENT_ITEM
properties.description: Relic, only one item with this property can be equipped at a time

name: Red Goo Breastplate
description: This breastplate gets all its wisdom from the old Googoo hairs used to make it. Everybody knows that you need to be old to be egoodite.

name: Green Goo Breastplate
description: This breastplate gets all its wisdom from the old Googoo hairs used to make it. Everybody knows that you need to be old to be egoodite.

name: Purple Goo Breastplate
description: This breastplate gets all its wisdom from the old Googoo hairs used to make it. Everybody knows that you need to be old to be egoodite.

name: Green Googulet
description: A Googoo amulet isn't the worst thing you could have around your neck... It's not far off, though.

name: Purple Googulet
description: A Googoo amulet isn't the worst thing you could have around your neck... It's not far off, though.

name: Shield in Briefs
description: No one will be able to say you're not wearing any underwear now!

name: The Absorber
description: This shield really can chew all that it bites off.

name: Ring O'Stradamus
description: This ring can see into the mists of your future, at least as far as the horrific defeat that's just around the corner.

name: Crackler Blade
description: This blade may not be sharp, but it certainly smarts!

name: Paw Pruner
description: If an enemy won't get his paws out of your business, then this shovel should help you cut him down to size.

properties.name: TREASURE
properties.description: Treasure Item (special interface)

name: Katastro Cards
description: These cards are disasters on legs. Send a few into enemy ranks to wreak havoc!

name: Bifmaro Bow
description: This juicy bow may look absolutely delicious, but gnawing on it will only make it less effective on the battlefield.

name: Wand of Courage
description: All those who continually flee fights, this is the wand for you. It won't actually make you any braver, but it will make you better at running away!

name: Cutting Edgies
description: These sneaky blades always find just the right moment to attack from behind.

name: Hohoglion Blade
description: You can tell a Hohoglian by his wealth, of course, but also by his haughty attitude. Carry this blade and you'll look elegant and well-to-do, even if you don't have a kama to your name.

name: Hoglian Sword
description: This sword was made by the great Karl Groucho, defender of the Hoglians. He engraved his famous maxim in its side: "XP is the opium of the people."

name: Hifipod Shovel
description: This weapon was invented by a smith who was sick of the booming bass coming from his neighbors' house. He used his creation to smash the source of their anti-social behavior to smithereens.

name: Crackdweller Staff
description: A cheeky staff.

name: Skyslicer
description: You can claim that this can slice the sky, but you'll just be blowing hot air.

name: Corpse Club
description: If you can get over the deathly stench, this club is sure to satisfy your more morbid urges.

name: Smash Hammer
description: A hammer created by Ms. Dinah Mitee, who used it to smash her enemies' smiles off their faces.

name: Necrofahrt Shield
description: The Necrofahrt shield - it wanted to be a trumpet when it was growing up!

name: Shield of Denial
description: This shield is frequently wrong, but it will never admit it.

name: Karne Epaulettes
description: These pretty epaulettes would go quite well with chili. If you can find any, that is...

name: Breastplate of Righteousness
description: Don't even bother arguing with this breastplate. It's ALWAYS right!

name: Cooper Cape
description: A cape as green as this will certainly bring you luck!

name: The Backdrop
description: Now people will have trouble sneaking up on you, from behind or from in front.

name: The Amule
description: An amulet that is a stubborn as a donkey, but knows how to watch its back!

name: Boowish Belt
description: The hairs on this very soft belt become strangely clingy when the sun goes down.

name: Boowish Hat
description: Boowolves fall pray to countless little nocturnal parasites. Thanks to this hat, you too can benefit from the extra waking hours they add to your day.

name: Boowish Epaulettes
description: What could be more reassuring than having two enormous Boowolf paws on your shoulders? Though have you noticed how the claws always feel like they're getting longer at night…?

name: The Hulfmoun
description: This shield has been weatherproofed using Boowolf hairs. It's not as efficient as the mythical Foolmoun, but it provides pretty good protection against droplets.

name: Boowish Boots
description: These boots give you the strange sensation of walking on your opponents' remains. At night, especially, they make some very unnerving sounds.

name: Elya Wood's Boots
description: Ideal for people who have naturally strong and hairy feet. These boots were designed with an extra-wide fitting.

name: Elya Wood's Hat
description: Friends of the community, this hat is made for you. It will enhance your reputation for heroism in the surrounding forests.

name: Elya Wood's Cloak
description: Thanks to this cloak, you will be lord of all the rings. It might be funny to start with, but you'll soon get fed up when you run out of fingers to wear them on...

name: Chaos Boots
description: These boots, valiantly designed to resist future floods, are watertight: you can wear them to splash around in puddles without worrying about getting your feet wet.

name: Chaos Hat
description: This hat seems to have weathered both winds and tides. It's also retained a subtle scent of must that shuffles its way into your nostrils on a regular basis.

name: Chaos Cloak
description: This cloak is so long and ugly, it could easily be used as a mop. Don't tell the little Eniripsa who went to so much trouble to make it, though...

name: Strangly Wand
description: This wand can tighten itself round your neck to strangle you. A very notable way to kill those you have little respect for.

name: Sargasse
description: Sargasse used to belong to a child with terrible powers. No one knows what has become of this weapon since it was exchanged for a bag of marbles.

name: Dazzling Belt
description: This belt lets you fire off spells incredibly fast, but it also makes you more fragile. So be careful not to get shot down like a Wodent…

properties.name: EXCLUSIVE_EQUIPMENT_ITEM_2
properties.description: Epic, only one item with this property can be equipped at a time

name: Toady
description: Red, white and very classy, this hat will make sure that all your ambassador evenings are a success.

name: Carnivorous Staff
description: Strangely sculpted, this staff doesn't come from around here. It smells of the darkness and dankness associated with Brakmar's old haunts.

name: Table Knives
description: These knives used to be used in a restaurant. Due to their strange appearance, the owner thought it better to sell them to a knife thrower instead.

name: Eachure Hat
description: This hat, made from Leather Chafer underpants, will make you irresistible to female Bworks, known for their femininity, which is accentuated by their ginger beards.

name: I Keeya Bow
description: Made in a warehouse in the north of Amakna, you assemble this cheap bow yourself. Its performance will depend on how good your DIY skills are.

name: Harmony
description: This pendant helps its wearer find peace with the world around them.

name: Bowisse Boots
description: These exceptional boots will make you faster during fights. Sorry about the smell, they used to belong to Bowisse.

name: Clint
description: The Clint is a dark hat, whose latest version appeals as much to seasoned adventurers as to flirty young ladies. Surely that's a sign of quality.

name: Seal of Companionship
description: Relentless work is always suitably rewarded!

properties.name: NOT_RECYCLABLE
properties.description: Non-recyclable (cannot be placed in a crusher)

name: Jack O'Lantern
description: With this lantern, you'll never need to be afraid of the dark again. It won't get rid of the creepy lurkers waiting to jump out at you, thought, it'll just light them up.

name: Whistle
description: Try not to use this Whistle too much around pretty girls, they might hold it against you for a while!

name: Mudguard
description: This shield will help you stay beautiful, even during the toughest fights.

name: Hearty Wand
description: Snap this in half and you'll have an ornament to give your sweetheart, and a toothpick for yourself.

name: Lil Challenger Mask
description: You are the Challenger!

name: Kanniball Mask
description: This mask will make a real vegetarian Kanniball out of you.

name: Vegebelt
description: Make sure you water this strip of greenery every day!

name: Truffelt
description:
Wear this belt right and your sense of smell will become incredibly sensitive.
You should consider plugging up your nose before you put it on.

name: Snapstrap
description: O snap!

name: Lucky Toadfoot
description: Apparently wearing a toad's foot around your neck will bring you fame and fortune. Apparently...

name: Lil Challenger Boots
description: Your challenge, should you choose to accept: to kick all the travelers' butts!

name: Lil Challenger Belt
description: Wear your Lil Challenger Belt proudly!

name: Domacion
description: Domacion became well-known for his work at the most famous farm in the land. He didn't stay for long, but he left this shovel behind as a souvenir.

name: Lil Challenger Cloak
description: You used to be a mere fighter. Now you are... a Challenger!

name: Richie Amulet
description:
Who you callin' 
an amulet?

name: Hotte Rod
description: This rod is highly effective thanks to the hook on the end of it. It's a subtle but useful invention.

name: Toomoowook
description: This ax's blade is so blunt that you couldn't cut wood with it properly if your life depended on it.

name: The Right Pick
description: Always ready at its owner's back for card games that aren't going in the right direction.

name: Aprophelmet
description: This helmet will help with that wibbly-wobbly balance of yours... unless of course you feel independent enough on your own!

name: The Oxster
description: The only helmet which will make you feel like you're wearing a Taur's armpit.

name: Boots of Destiny
description: Exploring crypts is a real kick!

name: Funeral Shroud
description: It wraps the body up perfectly.

name: Headgear of Destiny
description: This hat certainly belonged to a now dead rebuilder.

name: Epaulettes of Destiny
description: Put them on! It is your destiny!

name: Breastplate of Destiny
description: Blood, ectoplasmic sweat and tears went into making this breastplate… and it's still kind of soggy.

name: Grambo Ring
description: These little creatures can sometimes carry some pretty refined things.

name: Amulet of Respite
description: This amulet is a sight for sore eyes, especially your own.

name: Epaulettes of Respite
description: You'll be able to sleep soundly on your newly padded shoulders!

name: Cloak of Trouble
description: Sooo... this cloak is mean and troublesome. Wanna wear it?

name: The Baroness
description: This cloak will highlight your powerful stature as a young noob.

name: Breastplate of Trouble
description: This breastplate has a very unnerving gleam to it.

name: The Baron
description: Pull yourself up, puff out your chest, and hold your head high!

name: Ring of Trouble
description: Anyone who wears this ring will become crazy and aggressive.

name: Nobility Ring
description: A ring as magnificent as it is terrifying, worn by the master of an ancient noble family

name: Captain Hat
description: Do as Captain Panddock does and lower this cap over your eyes to block out the light.

name: Helm Shield
description: With this shield in your hands, your helm will always be manned.

properties.name: TREASURE
properties.description: Treasure Item (special interface)

name: Hat of Trouble
description: Pop this strange, black, round hat on so you don't have to see how sinister it looks sitting in your inventory.

name: Top Hat
description: A stylish top hat with luxurious side feather. You look just top!

name: Boots of Trouble
description: These troublesome boots were waxed with troubling black troublewax!

name: Belt of Destiny
description: Never fear, this belt doesn't remember it's old owner.

name: Carnivore Hat
description: Look! It's eating you alive!

name: Carnivore Epaulettes
description: As tender as Gobball steak.

name: Carnivore Cape
description: The perfect camouflage for the perfect predator!

name: Carnivore Ring
description: Finger-nibblin' good!

name: Carnivore Breastplate
description: A gutsy breastplate if ever I saw one!

name: Carnivore Amulet
description: With this amulet around your neck you're bound to get more than a few glances from hungry eyes.

name: Brambelt
description: It looks like it was nicked while it was asleep in the woods.

name: Leafy Ring
description: This ring is made of several leaf fibers.

name: Bouttes
description: Your feet will always feel fresh and moist in these!

name: Vegetaring
description: In case of emergency, use the oil given off by this ring to fry your enemies!

name: Bliblield
description: Blibli fur is extremely resistant. Once the hairs have been woven together even a Cra arrow shot at short range will just bounce off.

name: Pioneer Hat
description: Off on a quest for the New World? Don't forget this priceless Pioneer Hat, even if it's just to look snazzy.

name: Pioneer Cape
description: To be honest this cape doesn't really offer anything unique. But with a little imagination, you can make it into anything you like!

name: Pioneer Boots
description: Here you have the revolutionary, first-of-their-kind, waterproof, all-singing, all-dancing Pioneer Boots. With these on, you'll be able to rise above most situations in the World of Twelve.

name: Pioneer Epaulettes
description: These epaulettes, which subtly reflect rays of sunshine, have got what it takes to put even the Governor in the shade.

name: Bouquet of Roses
description: This bouquet of extremely rare eternal roses is beyond romantic. It's everything you need to light up people's hearts.

name: Fleaster Wodent Hat
description: Sweet like chocolate, this hat will keep you nice and wawm.

name: Fleaster Wodent Corset
description: A Fleaster Wodent 'round your pelvis? Woah, take it easy, hot stuff!

name: Fleaster Wodent Top
description: The pompoms don't really protect from enemy attack, but they're pretty darn sexy!

name: Fleaster Wodent Slippers
description: Could these slippers get any softer? Grab a mug of cocoa and prepare to feel at home in any Haven Bag.

name: Fleaster Wodent Amulet
description: This amulet is more difficult to come by than a lucky Wodent foot. Don't get eggy when it doesn't do anything special - it is, after all, completely and utterly useless!

name: Fleaster Wodent Ring
description: And, uh, who hasn't dreamed of having a Fleaster Wodent ring on their finger?

name: Shieldovore
description: As voracious as it is beautiful.

name: Gobbowler Epaulettes
description: These epaulettes are such good shock-absorbers that you won't be able to tell the difference between a hit from a War Chief and a Gobbowl Ball.

name: Gobbowler Boots
description: If anything will improve your butt-kicking skills it's these boots! The wooden spikes on the soles render them highly resistant. You stud-muffin…!

name: Gobbowler Breastplate
description: It's sexy, solid and soooo flattering! With this wrapped around your pecs, you feel ready to smash up any number of opponents!

name: Zinit Amulet
description:
Many moons ago, people used to say that wisdom was golden.
Now the only wisdom left in this World is embedded deep inside this amulet.

name: Zinit Boots
description: These boots allow plain sailing on the plains of Mount Zinit.

name: Zinit Cloak
description: This cloak will keep you dry on those rainy days.

name: Zinit Hat
description: This hat will probably give you hat hair.

name: Godfather Hat
description: This hat hides part of your face so that you can stay in the shade. The other part of your head will obviously be in the sun… The term hot head finally makes sense!

name: Moskito Amulet
description: Thanks to the Moskito eye adorning this amulet, you can anticipate oncoming danger from all four directions.

name: Willow Bow
description: This bow comes in a 0.5 version, but the 0.7, which is reinforced with willow wood, is much more comfortable to use.

name: Stetler Spike
description: Sharpened by a pro so your enemies can't possibly miss the point.

name: Slowshoes
description: Has time slowed down or is it just those funny new shoes of yours?

name: The Desperingo
description: With a ring like this, your chances of ending up in a cage go down.

name: Godfather Jacket
description: It's more or less the same as the jacket your disciples wear, but much better cut and at least twice as expensive. Don't want people thinking you're new around here, do ya?

name: Godfather Cloak
description: If you are planning on taking a disciple, choose carefully. You can be seen from afar in this cloak, so there'll be no getting away from him!

name: Godfather Shoes
description: Don't forget that big boots mean big responsibilities: watch out for the Bow Wow doo-doos or you will lose all credibility.

name: The Musselini
description: Handmade by Sufokian stallion, Il Musselini, this necklace is said to bring luck in the local mafia's white-knuckled card tournaments. That could just be because of its distracting stench, though.

name: Ye Jolly Good Olde Shield
description: In betwixt his afternoon teas, croquet and general larking about, local funnyman Mussel Grand had ample time to create yon shield. Say what you please about it, twill bounce right off.

name: Angora Bow Meow
description: How now Bow Meow?

name: Bow Meow
description: This Bow Meow is on the verge of perfection! He's very slightly less grumpy, selfish and lazy than most Bow Meows. Count yourself lucky!

name: Tofu
description: A cuddly little Tofu that's so cute you could eat it!

name: Tufty Tofu
description: This tongue-twisting Tofu has served useful for many an elocution lesson for the Iops of this World.

name: Striped Bow Meow
description: Striped Bow Meows are all crossbreeds of several species of Bow Meow. Bow Meow specialists believe this species are a lot more intelligent and daring than the others.

name: Makabrisdom Ring
description: This old, cursed ring has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Small Makabra Sword
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabra Hand
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabra Wand
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabra Staff
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabrards
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabragger
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabrabo
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabra Club
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Great Makabra Sword
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabraxe
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabrammer
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabra Shovel
description: This old, cursed weapon has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabrakfire Ring
description: This old, cursed ring has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabraspekting Ring
description: This old, cursed ring has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Makabraktion Ring
description: This old, cursed ring has broken free from the soul of its ex-master, who was killed in combat. Have you got what it takes to free the power held within...?

name: Dot
description: This little Gemlin is full of life and very boisterous. Since Mammy Pal's not that young anymore, she gave it to you so that it could accompany you on your adventures.

name: Fangulet
description: Careful with this amulet. It might just bite you in the middle of the night.

name: Axeivement
description: For those that like to get a job done and dusted!

name: Moonwalkers
description: These boots make walking backwards that little bit easier... and so much more stylish!

name: Lunar Boots
description: All the kids LOVE these boots - they're the kind that light up with every step you take. We know, we know, you used to have a pair…

name: Lunar Cloak
description: Unfortunately it won't fly you to the moon, nor let you play among the stars.

name: Lunaring
description:
They say he's got the whole World in his hands, but it looks like you've got the moon! 
Well, a bit of it, at least.

name: Lunar Breastplate
description: This breastplate glows in the moonlight.

name: Lunar Amulet
description: This amulet is a surprisingly effective night-light for those times when you just can't get off.

name: Demented Club
description: One blow of this club is enough to decapitate a Trool. The question is, are you strong enough to pick it up?

name: Hurdy Girdle
description: The little bells that adorn this belt jingle so violently that they make it impossible to sneak up on anyone. Look, it was either style or surprise. You can't have both!

name: Milimoowolf Amulet
description: Hell’s bells, this amulet is gorgeous!

name: Milimoowolf Bracelet
description: Don’t tighten it too much, now!

name: Milimoowolf Fleece
description: It’ll keep you nice and warm, even if you do look quite beastly!

name: Milimoowolf Headgear
description: This headgear will give onlookers the impression that a Milimoowolf ate you up and spat you straight back out again!

name: Crackly Helmet
description: This helmet might look pretty beat-up but there's some life in it yet.

name: Crackly Boots
description: Go on, have a crack at walking in these!

name: Crackly Ring
description: This ring is absolutely cracking, dahling.

name: Crackly Epaulettes
description: Make sure you don't crack under the strain of these epaulettes.

name: Roc Hammer
description: This hammer hits hard, if you can pick it up.

name: Steam Shovel
description: Great for digging up large stones and little Crackrocks.

name: Pumice Stone
description: This stone is great for removing dead, dry skin from the soles of your feet. You can even use it in battle, if you like!

name: Split Breastplate
description: Don't worry, it'll last for years yet.

name: Crobak Ring
description: You'll be able to make the feathers fly with this ring!

name: Featherypaulettes
description: These epaulettes are so feathery they'll almost make you gaga!

name: Crobak Amulet
description: Wearing this amulet is a bit like having a great big bird around your neck, which is why it won't really protect you from baddies.

name: Starry Boots
description: You're sure to be happy with these boots. They're covered in blue stars and foot the bill perfectly for walking on air!

name: Starry Cloak
description: If you want to reach for the stars, just chuck on this cloak. It might even help you climb every mountain.

name: Starry Hat
description: It's like having your head in the clouds… except that... it's in the...  stars…

name: Starry Ring
description: This ring will make you twinkle with joy!

name: Starry Breastplate
description: You can thank your lucky star you've found this breastplate!

name: Gobby Axe
description: This axe has always got something to say, and your enemies are almost definitely going to end up with a headache.

name: Osamodas's Hammer
description: Very useful for Osamodas, among others... Just watch your fingers.

name: Crobak Monocle
description: They say this monocle allows you to see everything with a bird's-eye view. Here's hoping the bird in question wasn't nearsighted!

name: Bluestar Shield
description: Use this shield to defend yourself and you'll leave your adversaries seeing stars!

name: Black Crow's Epaulettes
description: Become the master of darkness and fear your own strength!

name: Black Crow's Helmet
description: Don't forget to unfasten the leather straps that hold this helmet to your head…. It might be a bit difficult to take off otherwise!

name: Black Crow's Sword
description: A beautifully-decorated black sword that only the hardest of the World's warriors can control.

name: Woolly Boots
description: These boots will keep your feet lovely and warm, even in summer!

name: Crazy Shepherd Staff
description: Good luck using this staff to manage a herd of Wild Gobballs…

name: Woolly Amulet
description: A comforting woolen amulet.

name: Abrasive Cape
description: When you're not wearing this cape, you can use it as a very effective scouring pad.

name: Gobbsage Helmet
description: This impressively-built helmet will cause adventurers to come flocking around you like Gobblies. Oh, wait...

name: Gobbsage Breastplate
description: Don't be fooled by the softness of the wool, this breastplate will cut rocks like butter. It doesn't guarantee the safety of its wearer, however.

name: Gobbsage String
description: This amulet is a fine souvenir of your battle with Gobbsage.

name: Gobbsage Cape
description: This incredibly thick coat will keep you… incredibly warm!

name: Gobbsage Epaulettes
description: If you see someone charging towards you wearing these epaulettes, then for Eca's sake run as fast as you can in the other direction!

name: Old-School Shovel
description: This shovel is useful for unearthing all kinds of bits and pieces.

name: The Maimer
description: And yes, it really hurts!

name: Sacred Hood
description: The monks might not tell you this but it's very useful for taking a snooze during sermons.

name: Sacred Slippers
description: These slippers soothe tired feet and pre-emptively treat verrucas. Looks like they've got their work cut out with you.

name: Sacred Ring
description: It's possible that this ring has still got some saliva on it. Apparently, it's customary in the monastery for people to kiss one another's rings as a way of saying hello.

name: Sacred Tunic
description: This tunic, which is often worn during religious ceremonies, suits men as well as women.

name: Sacred Scepter
description: Give someone your blessing by bashing them on the head.

name: Old Cane
description: This cane is just as good at tripping people up as it is at helping you to walk.

name: Clergy Ring
description: Well, I'll be a monk's uncle! This ring is second to nun.

name: Old Slippers
description:
These slippers are so old and worn that you can see your enormous big toe sticking out of the end.
Mind you, that's not difficult, is it?

name: The Parish
description: Instantly absolves the sins of your enemies.

name: Clergyman Belt
description: It's hard to tell how many clergyman actually wear this belt, but it's supposed to help hold up your trousers.

name: Monk Hammer
description: This hammer can be used to ring church bells, or the heads of your enemies.

name: Birk 'n' Stocks
description: Now, where are my Jon Lemon glasses?

name: Nun Cloak
description: The temperature drops with this icy veil over your shoulders.

name: Wimple
description: Holy moly! Sister, you are looking goooood!

name: Nun Blouse
description: It'll freeze your skin until it bleeds!

name: Iron Cross
description: Cross your heart (but don't hope to die!).

name: Nunnish Doily
description: When you take this off, you can use it to protect the table from nasty stains.

name: Nun Scythe
description: Now you look like the Grim Reaper, but scarier.

name: Feather Duster
description: It gets deep into the dirtiest corners.

name: Forgiveness Bow
description: It will forgive your fallen opponents immediately.

name: Brush
description: You'll sort your enemies out in one clear sweep with this brush.

name: French Maid Helmet
description: This should come in handy in all sorts of situations!

name: Hairy Rat Headband
description: You look like you just crawled out of a sewer, you know.

name: Hairy Rat Ring
description: Watch where you put that finger! Oops, too late…

name: Hairy Rat Tail
description: Now you know why those Ecaflips were licking their lips when you walked past them a moment ago.

name: Hairy Rat Belt
description: Smell a rat…? Oh…

name: Rough Splinter Wand
description: Apparently this wand's last owner dropped it because he didn't have any fingers left.

name: Rat Collara
description: This dirty necklace might just give you some nasty diseases. Don't get pooped out!

name: Wakfu Era Helmet
description:
This headgear represents the passage from the Dofus Era to the Wakfu Era.
It marks chaos and revival.

name: Moowolf Bell
description: Now you can attack your enemies with bells on!

name: Moowolf Signet Ring
description: It'll sink its fangs into your finger!

name: Moowolf Finery
description: A well-earned hunting trophy!

name: Moowolf Headgear
description: Stand tall and proud in this headgear!

name: Baby Schnek
description: The Queen Schnek has passed on one of her many offspring.

name: Headfut
description: It might mess you around a bit, but it's made of genuine vampiric Borbat leather!

name: Twofut
description: So you can always set off on the right fut.

name: Waistfut
description: If you thought gaining a few inches around the middle was bad, try a whole fut!

name: Breastfut
description: This ultra-tight breastplate will give you super-hero abs!

name: Bow Meow Ears
description: Awww, who's a pwiddy puddy cat?!

name: Bow Meow Tail
description: Why, you look just purrrrfect!

name: Bow Meow Paws
description: Now you can learn how to walk the catwalk properly!

name: Zora's Helmet
description: If you like wearing this hat, it's because deep down you're just as annoying as Zora.

name: Zora's Amulet
description: This amulet is made for children during the Tofu ceremony.

name: Zora's Boots
description: Tell your tootsies it's their lucky day - these boots are as comfy as comfy could be!

name: Zora's Glove
description: This glove protects your hands from those capricious Tofu pecks.

name: Zora's Tunic
description: The sun will shine out of places you didn't know existed when you don this yellow Tofu tunic!

name: Zora's Cloak
description: This cloak makes a great blanky. Cozy on down for the night... Sweet dreams!

name: Fuzzy Cards
description: Fuzzy-wuzzy are these cards, these cards are fuzzy-wuzzy... Played correctly against an enemy you could make them quite muzzy.

name: Dead Ringer
description: This ring was found in a cemetery and exudes an aura that will make your blood run cold.

name: Gravey Hammer
description: When they said this hammer was all gravey, you didn't realize it felt most at home in a cemetery.

name: Tap Shoes
description: Clickety clack, clackety click!

name: Ragplate
description: Although this breastplate is in tatters, it's still reasonably useful.

name: Heaterettes
description: These Heaterettes offer a deep-heat effect that soothes all kinds of muscle pain.

name: Vampyric Epaulettes
description: Instead of going for the neck, these epaulettes suck blood from the shoulders.

name: Vampyric Breastplate
description:
It's normal to feel exhausted after wearing this breastplate...
It sucks the life right out of you.

name: Shadowed Amulet
description:
It might seem a bit shady but this amulet will protect you from sunburn... 
Hey, it's a lot cooler than whapping coats of colored sunblock on your face!

name: Vampyric Bracelet
description: Whoever said Vampyres suck? This stylish bracelet proves that they have a real eye for fashion.

name: Rock Bottoms
description: Just the clumps for when you're down in the dumps.

name: Vampiric Wand
description: At twilight, you can use this wand to fork your enemies' eyes out. By the time the new moon appears, they'll be doing it of their own accord.

name: Grave Shovel
description: For narcoleptics and tomb raiders.

name: Neckfut
description: In Forfut Village, lucky Wodent feet won't get you anywhere! Try one of these 100% organic Borbat-fiber amulets instead.

name: Royal Tofu Amulet
description: This royal amulet is perfect for all those flighty, feather-brained adventures.

name: Cassini Amulet
description: An amulet that goes with all your outfits...! There is a god!

name: Vampyro's Cape
description: This cape cost a fortune, but you feel like a male model in it, so what the neck!

name: Vampyro's Boots
description: The first step to fame is some trusty boots to kick butt with.

name: Vampyro's Belt
description: It almost looks as though this belt is sticking its tongue out to taunt you.

name: Shadofang Ring
description: Watch out! This ring might suck up more than just your soul!

name: Vampyro's Headgear
description: If you weren't pale and sickly already, then this headgear is just right for you!

name: Legano
description: Hold up... There's something funny about this ring!

name: Magician's Hat
description: The inside of this hat smells suspiciously like Wodents.

name: Old Belt
description: Even if this belt is slightly too large for your muscular torso, we recommend you hold on to it. Its value will become clear...

name: Pappy Pal's Ring
description: This ring used to belong to a long-lost, illustrious Enutrof. How on earth did it end up here...?

name: Dark Vlad's Wooden Sword
description: Carry this sword with pride as onlookers admire the tenacity and courage you bear having made it out alive from Dark Vlad's Maze.

properties.name: NOT_RECYCLABLE
properties.description: Non-recyclable (cannot be placed in a crusher)

name: Quaquack
description: Tofus, Gobballs and even Iops can't hold a candle to the Quaquack when it comes to sheer idiocy.

name: Bum Breastplate
description: This breastplate will make sure you hold on to your last kama, even when your closest friend is in need.

properties.name: NOT_RECYCLABLE
properties.description: Non-recyclable (cannot be placed in a crusher)

name: Bum Boots
description: These boots will allow you to rake up the earth at high speeds for maximum treasure-finding ability.

properties.name: NOT_RECYCLABLE
properties.description: Non-recyclable (cannot be placed in a crusher)

name: Bum Cloak
description: This cloak will allow you to instantly hide your provisions from wandering eyes.

properties.name: NOT_RECYCLABLE
properties.description: Non-recyclable (cannot be placed in a crusher)

name: Yugonets
description: Now you can try to get through customs without being stopped! But don't get too cocky…

name: The Grinder
description: This heavy, impractical sword is a must-have for anyone who wants to make friends at the Burnteca Tavern's legendary RnB nights.

name: Janairo Helmet
description: A story says that this helmet used to grace the head of a courageous Gobball. He disappeared without a trace one day and ever since, people have reported sightings of a winged face in the area where he used to live.

name: Peckish Helmet
description: This helmet was made for all those fans of our brainless feathered friends!

name: Deuldeu Breastplate
description: This breastplate will have a certain extra something that no other will.

name: Deuldeu Boots
description: These boots are just about wearable.

name: Deuldeu Helmet
description: This helmet will protect your face from oncoming arrows launched by inexperienced Cras.

name: Deuldeu Cloak
description: It might not look like anything special but you'll look cool wearing this cloak, promise.

name: Blazy Boots
description: These white-hot boots will set your steps on fire.

name: Hot Staff
description: If you're sitting there, eating your heart out, you need a Hot Staff.

name: O'Basan Spade
description: They say that Enutrofs are born with a golden spoon in their mouths. Amfufu!

name: Staypul Ring
description: Given that this ring was stapled onto your finger, expect a bit of blood when you decide to take it off.

name: Five Cawat Ring
description: This ring provides you with your five a day.

name: Cranny Faddocks
description: These boots, made out of leftover soup ingredients, were a gift from Auntie Cranny. Waste not, want not is all very well, but for a couple of days now you've been sure there are maggots crawling around between your toes...

name: Cankles
description: Please tell me those are boots...

name: Magic Roundabelt
description: Boiiing! Time for bed!

name: Crocobelt
description: This belt's buckle is as hard and scaly as a crocodile's snout. Once you snap it closed, there's no way you're getting it open again.

name: Krypto Cloak
description: Team with glowsticks for a fail-safe going-out look.

name: Messy Cape
description: For Gobbowl wonderkids and messy eaters. You only fit into the second category, unfortunately.

name: Gobbalrog Helmet
description: An incandescent helmet that is very good at keeping your ears warm during those chilly winters.

name: Gobbalrog Breastplate
description: As if the summer sun wasn't enough, here's a breastplate which aspires to be a radiator.

name: Gobbalrog Boots
description: These Gobbalrog Boots will allow you to give a good boot to any flaming Gobbowl Ball coming your way.

name: Gobbalrog Belt
description: With this belt, you're sure to be full of beans! Not suitable for those with sensitive skin. Beware of backfire.

name: Rogmourne
description: This legendary, icy sword was formerly carried by a Iop prince. His stay in the Gobbalrog's stomach made the sword glow and become even more powerful.

name: Gray Mage's Wand
description: This wand bears an almighty flame. It used to belong to a powerful mage and got terribly broken during an epic fight with a Gobbalrog.

name: The Mogmatic
description: With this on your arm, you can be sure of one thing... They shall not pass!

name: Magmog Feet
description: It's always easier to walk across lava with someone else's feet on. These have the added benefit of looking grood... I mean good. And great. Great and good.

name: Magmog Clinkers
description: These hot coals will teach all those friends who use you as a shoulder to cry on a lesson.

name: Magmog Cloak
description: The only known way to obtain this cloak is to give Magmog a cold and then whisk it off of his back at the most opportune moment.

name: Magmog Halo
description: As the famous enraged Iop once cried out: Halo? What?! he's never even played it!

name: Excarnus Fleece
description: This breastplate's curly virility is counteracted by the ectoplasmic gloop all over it. Talk about ruining the mood.

name: Excarnus's Crystal
description: This piece of jewelry was used to link Excarnus's soul to Gobbsage's ethereal body. A powerful artifact in the hands of an Excarnate… Do you really think you're capable of using its power?

name: Excarnus Hooves
description: As Gasper the friendly host once pointed out, these boots give you all sorts of airs and graces.

name: Excarnus Veil
description: A transparent veil which enables excarnates to become invisible. Many a man is pushing up daisies after trying too hard to obtain this precious item.

name: Tortured Soul
description: It may be small, but this ring contains a fragment of Gobbsage's essence, absorbed long ago by Excarnus. Pop it in your mouth. It tastes like angry, digested hay.

name: Milkar Finery
description: This cloak has a beastly smell that risks causing undesirable secondary effects that will send you howling to the moon.

name: Milkar Fangs
description: These fangs are just what you need to complete your Moowolf Al Howin's outfit… Just remember to take them off if you're kissing your sweetheart.

name: Milkar Fur
description: With one of these ferocious specimens on your front and one on your back, you'll look like... well, a beast with two backs.

name: Milkar Mitts
description: An accessory made for scratching hard-to-get-to places - just what you needed! A word of advice, though: with claws like that, you shouldn't use it anywhere... sensitive.

name: The Bloodthirsty
description: Careful who you give this dagger to. It feeds on the blood of its victims, or on that of its owner, one week per month.

name: White Crow Hackle
description: A soft, comfortable, floaty, three-ply, feathery neck-dress. Just what you need to wipe enemies out!

name: White Crow Amulet
description: A powerful piece of jewelry that gives its bearer a second personality. Something to bring out your dark side!

name: White Crow Breastplate
description: A very rare item made of white crow feathers. The only way to get those is to kill a Black Crow... It's said that they turn white when they die.

name: White Crow Belt
description: A very trendy belt, ideal for clubbing. Thanks to its high visibility, this belt can be spotted from a distance, even when it's pitch black.

name: White Crow Wings
description: Fly into the face of danger with these wings. As angelic as they might seem, they're devilishly uncomfortable!

name: Milimoowolf
description: So sweet and cute and Milimoowolfy!

name: Arachnee
description: This little Arachnee will very quickly dodge your huggles.

name: Clawbot
description: More loyal than an organic pet, the Clawbot will follow you absolutely everywhere.

name: Robust
description: This sublimation fits into a relic item to increase the wearer's stats.

name: Ice Lance
description: This staff is as cold as ice and is willing to sacrifice... itself.

name: Lightning
description: This lightning won't strike the same place twice.

name: Roseyposey
description: A rose by any other name would smell just as sweet... But you're stuck with this stupidly named one now!

name: Hobble Stick
description: To help Enutrofs hobble along the Astrub cobbles and prevent wobbling during Gobball squabbles. Now say it over and over again.

name: Raval Scepter
description: The sinister protector enshrined Menalt's skull in his staff and a shiver shuddered through the World, as if all the sleeping souls had let out a cry.

name: Djaul Dagger
description: This dagger symbolizes all the power of Djaul, infamous demon and disciple, student, and loyal eye of his master, Rushu.

name: Solar Sword
description: This golden, illuminated sword will unleash its full potential at around midday. It represents the first protector of Javian, Solar. May the sun shine upon you.

name: Ten Ton Hammer
description: This hammer symbolizes all the power of Menalt, the centaur warrior and first protector of Martalo.

name: Water Krosmunster
description: The World of Twelve is still trying to determine if this little critter is related to Hel Munster of the erstwhile Treechnid Forest. All that is known is that if you're kind enough, it'll bring you monstrous bonuses!

name: Whispered Lance
description: Whisperers' lances always find their targets. It's said that their owners whisper them detailed directions before they go into battle.

name: Whispered Hand
description: This hand has been trained to jab people in sensitive areas.

name: Whispered Amulet
description: This pendant echoes with the wispy whispers of lingering Whisperers.

name: Whispered Ring
description: The best ring by a whisper.

name: Whispered Breastplate
description: This breastplate has absorbed gallons of whispers over the years. Why not just let it have a rest in your inventory now?

name: Whispered Helmet
description: This headgear will have you turning in circles trying to figure out who's whispering your name.

name: Whispered Cloak
description: Sheathe your body in a spine-tingling whisper.

name: Whispered Belt
description: If nobody else will whisper sweet nothings to you, at least your belt will.

name: Feroxxors Boowolf
description: Only a Meridian Star can claim the right to ride this impressive Destruction mount. Its rippling muscles cut an imposing figure.

name: Rocky Fist
description: The expression 'under the thumb' takes on a new dimension when the thumb in question belongs to a Whispered Crackler.

name: Bastile Helmet
description: One piece of clothing that should always go down a storm.

name: Whispered Standard
description: A versatile adventurer like you can make heads roll with any old piece of junk, flags included.

name: Rampart Boots
description: Be inapproachable. Rampart Boots.

name: Rampart Amulet
description: It protects the body and mind with a single look.

name: Rampart Epaulettes
description: Charge your enemies with these on and they'll feel like they've just been run over by a truck. On the other hand, they take so much effort to wear that so will you.

name: Rampart Belt
description: Protects against: cannonballs. Does not protect against: groin strains.

name: Hushed Scepter
description: This scepter is said to contain the sighs and murmurs of ancient kings.

name: Hushed Epaulettes
description: Hey dude, they'll do; the murmur you need is on your shoulders.

name: Whispery Ring
description: One ring to bring them all and with a murmur bind them.

name: Hushed Boots
description: As you walk, these boots count your steps under their breath.

name: Hushed Breastplate
description: Its wearer will be protected by the ancient Whisperers' murmurs.

name: Hushed Crown
description: Perfect for indecisive monarchs, this crown will whisper you in the right direction.

name: Hushed Cloak
description: A cloak with which to conspire in the dusty corners of libraries.

name: Hushed Amulet
description: They say that this amulet's original wearer woke up one of the first Cracklers.

name: Hushed Belt
description: It's just (hush!) a little crush (hush!)...

name: Gravel Gavel
description: One call for order with this hammer and you'll be out stone cold.

name: Crackwhip Bow
description: The Cracklers tried their hand at writing by carving a few incomprehensible words on this bow: Although this bow poor...

name: Ringapult
description: It'll drive your enemies ballistic!

name: Whispery Hand
description: Apparently this hand has picked hundreds of locks without ever saying a word.

name: Whispery Pristplate
description: The Whisperers make their prisoners wear breastplates like this one so they can be spotted from afar if they make a run for it.

name: Whispering Clogs
description: Oooh... New shhhoes!

name: Whispery Standard Cloak
description: This well-aired fabric will do just fine as a back-up cloak.

name: Murmurderer
description: The mere sight of it will have your enemies whispering blue murder.

name: Wizard Costume
description: So... If he weighs the same as a Quaquack, he's definitely a wizard!

properties.name: SHOP_ITEM
properties.description: Shop Item (item available only in the shop)

name: Jacko Costume
description: This costume is a bit wacko but pleases the kids.

properties.name: SHOP_ITEM
properties.description: Shop Item (item available only in the shop)

name: Ghoul Costume
description: Get up and ghoul.

properties.name: SHOP_ITEM
properties.description: Shop Item (item available only in the shop)

name: Earth Krosmunster
description: The World of Twelve is still trying to determine if this little critter is related to Hel Munster of the erstwhile Treechnid Forest. All that is known is that if you're kind enough, it'll bring you monstrous bonuses!

name: Air Krosmunster
description: The World of Twelve is still trying to determine if this little critter is related to Hel Munster of the erstwhile Treechnid Forest. All that is known is that if you're kind enough, it'll bring you monstrous bonuses!

name: Fire Krosmunster
description: The World of Twelve is still trying to determine if this little critter is related to Hel Munster of the erstwhile Treechnid Forest. All that is known is that if you're kind enough, it'll bring you monstrous bonuses!

name: Aesof Mace
description: This mace resonates with northern pop music - it should be enough to wake up even the sleepiest Cracklers.

name: Imperial Gobball Helmet
description: This helmet is supposed to help you get all those pesky Gobballs under your thumb.

name: Imperial Tofu Helmet
description: This helmet will make it very easy for you to hide in amongst a group of Tofus. Useful, right?

name: Alpha Predator Helmet
description: This helmet will grant its wearer the inimitable power of sniffing out thermal emissions.

name: Imperial Gobball Cape
description: The perfect extra blanket for the chilly winter ahead.

name: Imperial Tofu Cloak
description: Judging by the bloodstains all over this cloak, it probably doesn't give you the power to fly.

name: Alpha Predator Cloak
description: I'd tell you that this cloak is said to provide the perfect camouflage, but you appear to have disappeared. Never mind!

name: Imperial Gobball Epaulettes
description: These epaulettes will have you feeling like you're dancing on the clouds.

name: Imperial Tofu Epaulettes
description: These epaulettes are useful if not very manly.

name: Alpha Predator Epaulettes
description: There's what looks like an empty fitting on these epaulettes, suggesting that they used to include some kind of mechanism.

name: Imperial Gobball Ring
description: Strangely enough, this ring is covered in slobber.

name: Alpha Predator Ring
description: Don't worry, its bark is worse than its bite.

name: Imperial Tofu Amulet
description: There's a picture of a Tofoone inside - awww.

name: Alpha Predator Amulet
description: Never put this amulet in direct contact with your skin.

name: Imperial Gobball Breastplate
description: A breastplate to be proud of - go on, stick out that chest!

name: Imperial Tofu Belt
description: How ironic that the only time you feel as free as a bird is when you're strapped tightly into a belt that's obviously too small for you.

name: Alpha Predator Belt
description: For once, if you hear gurgling, it's probably not coming from your stomach.

name: Imperial Tofu Boots
description: A little peep of terror escapes these boots as you put your feet in them.

name: Imperial Gobball Boots
description: These boots will make you feel hot, hot, hot! And look not so hot!

name: Imperial Summoner Armor
description: Only summoners capable of handling a real menagerie are worthy of wearing this armor.

name: Imperial Healer Epaulettes
