description: The Krawsh embellishes the outfits of Kreublo youths, and really shows off their plumage too.

name: Lance Acrid
description: The Raskaw legend says that this lance was brought to the Lands of Kelba by the original Grand Orrok. It will reinforce your link to the sacred spirit on contact, on nights where the full moon is partly hidden by clouds.

name: Orrok's Headgear
description: This headgear is worn by the village chief in order to distinguish himself from his peers.

name: Grand Orrok Loincloth
description: With this loincloth, you can have the best-looking assets in the woods.

name: Orrok Shoes
description: In the mountains, you have to keep on your feet - it will help keep you from falling to your death!

name: Kreublo Plumage
description: Kreublo youths generally have softer and silkier plumage than the adults. The difference is really pretty subtle though.

name: Kreublo Amulet
description: This Amulet is offered to young members of Kreublos winging their way through the Lands of Kelba to give them the courage of the Orrok.

name: The Orrok Spirit
description: The link the Raskaw people have with their ancestors makes all the more powerful.

name: Orrok's Wings
description: Magnificent wings linked to the Orrok spirit. Or at least a very good imitation!

name: Rat Collara
description: This dirty necklace might just give you some nasty diseases. Don't get pooped out!

name: Rat Collara
description: This dirty necklace might just give you some nasty diseases. Don't get pooped out!

name: Hairy Rat Ring
description: Watch where you put that finger! Oops, too late…

name: Hairy Rat Ring
description: Watch where you put that finger! Oops, too late…

name: Hairy Rat Belt
description: Smell a rat…? Oh…

name: Hairy Rat Belt
description: Smell a rat…? Oh…

name: Hairy Rat Headband
description: You look like you just crawled out of a sewer, you know.

name: The Ratpatch
description: This breastplate was cobbled together using patches of fabric and armor from all the members of the Rat family.

name: The Ratpatch
description: This breastplate was cobbled together using patches of fabric and armor from all the members of the Rat family.

name: Hairy Rat Tail
description: Now you know why those Ecaflips were licking their lips when you walked past them a moment ago.

name: Rough Splinter Wand
description: Apparently this wand's last owner dropped it because he didn't have any fingers left.

name: Belly Clencher
description: The instructions on the packet say that, if you hit your enemy in just the right spot, some of his body parts will pop right out! But where...? Now, that's the question.

name: Ratical Cloak
description: Whip this cloak round to the front and you can use it as a bib. To be honest, the smell coming off it is making you drool already...

name: Ratical Headgear
description: This rat may be stuffed, but the halitosis it suffered in life has become stronger than ever in death. When you're walking around town, you part crowds without even trying!

name: Ratical Ring
description: This ring used to belong to Ratical's mother. Apparently, whoever's wearing it is the life and soul of the party!

name: Ratty Riot Shield
description: This shield is made up of all the body parts that were left over after one of Ratical's riotous parties. If you can bear to carry it, you probably don't realize that's what it's made of.

name: Ratical Ring
description: Oh, don't worry, it's not a worm! It's just a hairless, creepy, squidgy rat tail. Watch out for splinters!

name: Ratto Rake
description: When Lady Gardenmore invented this tool for gathering dead leaves into piles, Sir Slayalday couldn't wait to borrow it to do the same thing with enemies' corpses. Each to their own.

name: Rattagain Amulet
description: This amulet's goal is to keep you on the straight and narrow... Although, judging by the direction you've taken so far, I'm not sure going straight on is ideal...

name: Boowish Boots
description: These boots give you the strange sensation of walking on your opponents' remains. At night, especially, they make some very unnerving sounds.

name: Boowish Boots
description: These boots give you the strange sensation of walking on your opponents' remains. At night, especially, they make some very unnerving sounds.

name: Boowish Belt
description: The hairs on this very soft belt become strangely clingy when the sun goes down.

name: Boowish Belt
description: The hairs on this very soft belt become strangely clingy when the sun goes down.

name: Boowish Hat
description: Boowolves fall pray to countless little nocturnal parasites. Thanks to this hat, you too can benefit from the extra waking hours they add to your day.

name: Boowish Hat
description: Boowolves fall pray to countless little nocturnal parasites. Thanks to this hat, you too can benefit from the extra waking hours they add to your day.

name: Boowish Epaulettes
description: What could be more reassuring than having two enormous Boowolf paws on your shoulders? Though have you noticed how the claws always feel like they're getting longer at night…?

name: Fangulet
description: Careful with this amulet. It might just bite you in the middle of the night.

name: Fangulet
description: Careful with this amulet. It might just bite you in the middle of the night.

name: The Hulfmoun
description: This shield has been weatherproofed using Boowolf hairs. It's not as efficient as the mythical Foolmoun, but it provides pretty good protection against droplets.

name: Boowolf Breastplate
description: Since this breastplate arrived on the market, a new fighting technique has been seen on the battlefield. It's known as 'tufting.'

name: Boowolf String
description: Yes, Boowolwes also wear Strings, so what? Everyone is entitled to their share of femininity!

name: Lunaring
description:
They say he's got the whole World in his hands, but it looks like you've got the moon! 
Well, a bit of it, at least.

name: Lunar Boots
description: All the kids LOVE these boots - they're the kind that light up with every step you take. We know, we know, you used to have a pair…

name: Lunar Cloak
description: Unfortunately it won't fly you to the moon, nor let you play among the stars.

name: Noke's Talisman
description: This lucky amulet will protect you from those uneasy midnight encounters.

name: Noke's Mask
description:
This mask can be pretty terrifying
if worn in the forestand will really bring out your wild side.

name: Brutal Tiara
description: Not for brutes.

name: Arachneean Cloak
description:
The label reads "Gentle, even when rubbed the wrong way."
A characteristic you often don't find with adventurers, unfortunately.

name: Arachneean Cloak
description:
The label reads "Gentle, even when rubbed the wrong way."
A characteristic you often don't find with adventurers, unfortunately.

name: Fluo Ring
description: Once you've put this ring on, it's highly recommended that you take it off again. You have been warned...

name: Fluo Ring
description: Once you've put this ring on, it's highly recommended that you take it off again. You have been warned...

name: The Phosphorescent
description: This belt can also be used as a hi-vis band to make your Dragoturkey visible to other path users on dark nights.

name: The Phosphorescent
description: This belt can also be used as a hi-vis band to make your Dragoturkey visible to other path users on dark nights.

name: Arachneean Breastplate
description: Your eyes are bigger than your belly.

name: Arachneean Boots
description: Hairy inside and out.

name: Arachneean Boots
description: Hairy inside and out.

name: Arachneean Headgear
description: If you can't have an extra set of eyes on your back, you can at least have them on your head.

name: Nu-Clear Cudgel
description: Whatever numbskull takes this cudgel in the face is likely to sprout a third eye on a stalk. Choose your targets well.

name: The Supernova
description: When used, this wand releases pretty sparks in all different colors. It's not very good for the planet, but it's so cute!

name: Black Widow Boots
description: The Black Widow has tons of these boots to spare, which is just as well, because Rogue magazine says they're in this season!

name: Black Widow Cloak
description: This cloak was woven thread by thread by the meticulous Black Widow herself. A Catapulted Crackler would have no chance against it, so I don't know why you're so quick to put it on your back.

name: Black Widow Ring
description: I suppose she doesn't need it any more, now she's a widow.

name: The Toxispike
description: The Black Widow bamboozled an Arachnee Embroiderer and nabbed one of its hands for her own dastardly designs.

name: Zizotopes
description: Boots with a built-in rhythm system to make sure you step to the beat! That part in the pantomime might be yours at last!

name: Phosphorescent Clasp
description: From above, you look like a radioactive toadstool!

name: Phosphorescent Amulet
description: This amulet may look like an Al Howin's Treat, but that's no reason to eat it.

name: Bwork Harvester
description: Death to Bworks!

name: Ancestral Treechnid Ring
description: This ring is nice... I mean, in an understated way. It looks good on you. I wouldn't wear one myself, but you know...

name: Seeping Bwork Boots
description: You've always wanted to walk a mile in a Bwork's shoes, but you didn't think of the half-inch of scum and sweat that would be left behind... Squelch! but you didn't think of the half-inch of scum and sweat that would be left behind... Squelch! Urgh!

name: Seeping Bwork Boots
description: You've always wanted to walk a mile in a Bwork's shoes, but you didn't think of the half-inch of scum and sweat that would be left behind... Squelch! but you didn't think of the half-inch of scum and sweat that would be left behind... Squelch! Urgh!

name: Brown Bwork Cape
description: It's said that the leather used in making this cape was tanned using the secretions of a Wild Gobball. This is only a rumor though. The truth is far worse.

name: Brown Bwork Cape
description: It's said that the leather used in making this cape was tanned using the secretions of a Wild Gobball. This is only a rumor though. The truth is far worse.

name: Greasy Bwork Helmet
description: Some say the Bworks never take their armor off and never wash it. They never wash themselves either, for that matter.

name: Greasy Bwork Helmet
description: Some say the Bworks never take their armor off and never wash it. They never wash themselves either, for that matter.

name: Patched Bwork Breastplate
description: Despite the primitive craftsmanship, this breastplate seems pretty solid. It would be perfect for combat, were it not for the odor of Bwork wafting from literally every surface.

name: Bwork Sword
description: Simple and effective, this blade is designed more to crush than cut. The only thing that makes you doubt its combat-worthiness is the sticky handle...

name: Bwork Sword
description: Simple and effective, this blade is designed more to crush than cut. The only thing that makes you doubt its combat-worthiness is the sticky handle...

name: Bwork Shield
description: You've turned it this way and that, and still cannot understand how they got the iron around the wooden center. Unless they somehow inserted the wooden center into the iron? You may never know...

name: Bworcine Pedalian Cincture
description: Don't be fooled by the highfalutin name. It's said this "cincture" is actually the repurposed toe ring of what must be the biggest Bwork in history. As we all know, as the dimensions of a Bwork increase by a factor of n, Bwork surface area increases by n squared. Much more skin to catch the sun. At the same time, Bwork volumetric mass increases by n cubed. Much, much more fat to soak up the sun and insulate. Which all amounts to a really fat, really sweaty Bwork with a really sweaty toe ring. Lots.

name: Immaculate Bwork Amulet
description: This Bwork amulet is fairly disturbing. Other than the delicateness which it was created with compared to normal Bwork products, it's its cleanliness which is most shocking! Oh! But of course. The cord is much too short to go around the head and ears of a Bwork.

name: Thork Epaulettes
description: Solid, simple, effective. Thork likes massive epaulettes. That way, he looks like he's more than just a Bwork.

name: Thork Amulet
description: Thork's only apparently useless accessory, the amulet is made of the beard of an ancient Bwork named Nad'Lug. In actuality, it's really powerful.

name: Thork Boots
description: The spikes on Thork's boots had always impressed his fellow Bwork Explorers. It's plain to see they've been used to kick a few butts...

name: The Watch
description: Now that you have the Watch, time is in your hands! You can be as late as you like!

name: Yamato's Rope
description: Yamato's Rope has made more than one monster's heart beat a little faster. A finely tuned weapon, it can direct arrows to even the most well-hidden targets.

name: Cape Huccino
description: This cape was made with just one goal in mind: It had to be able to keep its owner awake for a few days running.

name: Wild Gobball Epaulettes
description: Now, the weight of the wool is on your shoulders. Ancient Gobball Hunter proverb

name: Wild Gobball Epaulettes
description: Now, the weight of the wool is on your shoulders. Ancient Gobball Hunter proverb

name: Wild Gobball Ring
description: This ring will wear your fingers to the bone.

name: Wild Gobball Ring
description: This ring will wear your fingers to the bone.

name: Wild Gobball Helmet
description: One thing is certain: if you come across a Bow Meow, it will curl up for a nice nap in your warm headgear.

name: Wild Gobball Helmet
description: One thing is certain: if you come across a Bow Meow, it will curl up for a nice nap in your warm headgear.

name: Wild Gobball Breastplate
description: It's been said that with this breastplate, you could stroll around Frigost almost completely naked. Note the word "survive" was not mentioned.

name: Hammer of Savagery
description: With this hammer you have one and only one desire: smash, smash and SMASH!

name: Hammer of Savagery
description: With this hammer you have one and only one desire: smash, smash and SMASH!

name: Wild Belt
description: This belt is as warm as it is odorous.

name: Staff of Great Wisdom
description: The wise man admits he knows nothing. He also doesn't mess with someone wielding this staff.

name: Abrasive Cape
description: When you're not wearing this cape, you can use it as a very effective scouring pad.

name: Great Wild Gobball Ring
description: Although it's a real Wild Gobball bone, its magic virtues remain to be proven.

name: Great Wild Gobball Boots
description: The wilder the Great Gobball was, the more getting kicked in the butt with these boots will hurt.

name: Feesy's Bow
description: Can shoot odoriferous and, frankly, disgusting arrows.

name: Sharpened Claymore
description: This enormous sword is efficient at turning even the largest enemies into hamburger meat. Just make sure you don't do that swishy figure-of-eight thing to celebrate - your teammates will thank you.

name: Daudgee
description: The Daudgee is made from Ouginak remains and various other refuse. Worn by Gourlo the Terrible for a long time, the Daudgee is the image of desolation.

name: Aristocrab Staff
description: This staff was made with the upper classes in mind. Equip it and you'll feel like a nobleman, even in the middle of a bloody battle.

name: Haunted Ring
description: If your finger starts breathing by itself when you put this ring on, relax: it's just the soul of a tortured pirate who's been trapped inside for several decades.

name: Haunted Ring
description: If your finger starts breathing by itself when you put this ring on, relax: it's just the soul of a tortured pirate who's been trapped inside for several decades.

name: Anteak Boots
description: These boots are made of 100% authentic ghostof fabric. They're gonna live forever!

name: Anteak Boots
description: These boots are made of 100% authentic ghostof fabric. They're gonna live forever!

name: Bully Nightcap
description: No need to toot your own horn, but you look very respecta-bull with this hat on. Toot toot!

name: Bully Nightcap
description: No need to toot your own horn, but you look very respecta-bull with this hat on.

name: Backagens
description: What do you mean, you saw them just yesterday? They've been dead for twenty yeeeaaars…!

name: Deckhand Belt
description: A sailor belt made from a length of old rope. It's not fancy, but it'll do the job.

name: Deckhand Belt
description: A sailor belt made from a length of old rope. It's not fancy, but it'll do the job.

name: Deckhand Torso
description: This breastplate is so battered and worn that you could easily pretend to be a shipwreck survivor and cadge a lift off a friendly ship.

name: Agis Shovel
description: Many Enutrofs swear loyalty to this shovel because they think it will help them find treasure. All it ever seems to dig up is dirty underpants, though. Is faith really this blind?

name: Protecto Plasm
description: This high-tech shield draws its resistance from all the souls it has captured. Its hardiness is matched only by its stickiness!

name: Hurling Cloak
description: Just so you know, if you ever feel some trapped wind letting loose, this cloak will turn green and start vibrating violently.

name: Ephurlettes
description: These epaulettes' inbuilt ventilation system will have you churning out stale, piratey air 24/7.

name: Hurlplate
description: This breastplate is a little too tight, but to be honest, if you're happy wearing a garment made of old Ghostofs, you obviously don't care much about your appearance.

name: Tauxik Hammer
description: When this hammer hits the ground, a nauseating stench fills the vicinity. It's in your best interest to learn how to fight from a distance, and fast!

name: Deckhand Ring
description: Embellished with a skull to give you the bad-boy look you've been coveting so.

name: Deckhand Boots
description: These boots have a good grip on them to stop the seamen falling flat on their faces.

name: Privateer Belt
description: This belt offers a handy spot for pirates to store their aces when playing cards (everyone knows their sleeves were long ago ripped off by raging captains, crocodiles, or the wear and tear of sea life).

name: Elite Riktus Epaulettes
description: If you are short of ideas, you could always use these epaulettes to smash up walls as well as your enemies.

name: Elite Riktus Breastplate
description: At first glance, this breastplate seems as light as a feather. In reality it's as heavy as a sack of bricks. Make sure you buff up before attempting to put it on!

name: Kapow Ring
description:
"One ring, biff kapow. Two rings, biff bang kablooey!"
Nostralanus - Thoughts

name: Kapow Ring
description:
"One ring, biff kapow. Two rings, biff bang kablooey!"
Nostralanus - Thoughts

name: Kapow Belt
description: This belt does everything. Well, almost. Kapow sock whack!

name: Kapow Belt
description: This belt does everything. Well, almost. Kapow sock whack!

name: Kapow Breastplate
description: A lightly perfumed breastplate which is wonderfully attractive to hungry Gobballs in the area.

name: Kapow Breastplate
description: A lightly perfumed breastplate which is wonderfully attractive to hungry Gobballs in the area.

name: Kapow Helmet
description: This helmet is as light as a feather. All you have to do is wait for the wind to get up to turn your dreams of flying into reality... Crash Bang Wallop *stars*... Maybe not.

name: Kapow Thongs
description: Hitting with your bare hands is overrated. Awkkkkkk ooooff cr-r-a-a-ck clunk-eth.

name: Kapow Thongs
description: Hitting with your bare hands is overrated. Awkkkkkk ooooff cr-r-a-a-ck clunk-eth.

name: The Country
description: Aaaah! You've finally decided to let him slip his ring over your finger!

name: Bouttes
description: Your feet will always feel fresh and moist in these!

name: Vegetaring
description: In case of emergency, use the oil given off by this ring to fry your enemies!

name: Carnivore Amulet
description: With this amulet around your neck you're bound to get more than a few glances from hungry eyes.

name: Carnivore Epaulettes
description: As tender as Gobball steak.

name: Carnivore Breastplate
description: A gutsy breastplate if ever I saw one!

name: Alpha Predator Amulet
description: Never put this amulet in direct contact with your skin.

name: Alpha Predator Belt
description: For once, if you hear gurgling, it's probably not coming from your stomach.

name: Alpha Predator Cloak
description: I'd tell you that this cloak is said to provide the perfect camouflage, but you appear to have disappeared. Never mind!

name: Leafy Ring
description: This ring is made of several leaf fibers.

name: Brambelt
description: It looks like it was nicked while it was asleep in the woods.

name: Crackly Ring
description: This ring is absolutely cracking, dahling.

name: Crackly Ring
description: This ring is absolutely cracking, dahling.

name: Crackly Boots
description: Go on, have a crack at walking in these!

name: Crackly Boots
description: Go on, have a crack at walking in these!

name: Crackly Helmet
description: This helmet might look pretty beat-up but there's some life in it yet.

name: Crackly Helmet
description: This helmet might look pretty beat-up but there's some life in it yet.

name: Crackly Epaulettes
description: Make sure you don't crack under the strain of these epaulettes.

name: Crackler Blade
description: This blade may not be sharp, but it certainly smarts!

name: Crackler Blade
description: This blade may not be sharp, but it certainly smarts!

name: Roc Hammer
description: This hammer hits hard, if you can pick it up.

name: The Party Bloc
description: The only breastplate that will make you want to bop your head - and your enemies' heads!

name: Cracka Smile
description: This ring is said to confer a mystical smile-cracking power on its wearer. Looking at it, though, perhaps it's not so mystical after all.

name: Stone Cold Boots
description: These boots have been readily available ever since they were banned from Gobbowl tournaments. Apparently they weren't hardcore enough.

name: Stone Cold Cloak
description: A bad cloak for running the 100 kameters in. A good cloak for blending into your surroundings in the Holey Forest!

name: Stone Cold Helmet
description: If you've ever seen a Crackrock performing the ancient fight move known as a headbutt, you'll know that you're better off inside this helmet than out.

name: Hellmut
description: Looks like someone came last in the spelling bee... All the same, nobody would ever say it to your face, not when you look this scary.

name: Split Breastplate
description: Don't worry, it'll last for years yet.

name: Steam Shovel
description: Great for digging up large stones and little Crackrocks.

name: Conquered Raziel
description: The flood seems to have been hugely beneficial to this blessed sword, which has drawn a new and vengeful power from the water.

name: Milkar Fangs
description: These fangs are just what you need to complete your Moowolf Al Howin's outfit… Just remember to take them off if you're kissing your sweetheart.

name: Milkar Fur
description: With one of these ferocious specimens on your front and one on your back, you'll look like... well, a beast with two backs.

name: Milkar Finery
description: This cloak has a beastly smell that risks causing undesirable secondary effects that will send you howling to the moon.

name: Milkar Mitts
description: An accessory made for scratching hard-to-get-to places - just what you needed! A word of advice, though: with claws like that, you shouldn't use it anywhere... sensitive.

name: Hurdy Girdle
description: The little bells that adorn this belt jingle so violently that they make it impossible to sneak up on anyone. Look, it was either style or surprise. You can't have both!

name: Demented Club
description: One blow of this club is enough to decapitate a Trool. The question is, are you strong enough to pick it up?

name: Moowolf Signet Ring
description: It'll sink its fangs into your finger!

name: Moowolf Bell
description: Now you can attack your enemies with bells on!

name: Moowolf Headgear
description: Stand tall and proud in this headgear!

name: Excarnus's Crystal
description: This piece of jewelry was used to link Excarnus's soul to Gobbsage's ethereal body. A powerful artifact in the hands of an Excarnate… Do you really think you're capable of using its power?

name: Excarnus Hooves
description: As Gasper the friendly host once pointed out, these boots give you all sorts of airs and graces.

name: Moowolf Finery
description: A well-earned hunting trophy!

name: Excarnus Fleece
description: This breastplate's curly virility is counteracted by the ectoplasmic gloop all over it. Talk about ruining the mood.

name: Excarnus Veil
description: A transparent veil which enables excarnates to become invisible. Many a man is pushing up daisies after trying too hard to obtain this precious item.

name: Old-School Shovel
description: This shovel is useful for unearthing all kinds of bits and pieces.

name: The Maimer
description: And yes, it really hurts!

name: Gobbsage Cape
description: This incredibly thick coat will keep you… incredibly warm!

name: Gobbsage Epaulettes
description: If you see someone charging towards you wearing these epaulettes, then for Eca's sake run as fast as you can in the other direction!

name: Gobbsage Helmet
description: This impressively-built helmet will cause adventurers to come flocking around you like Gobblies. Oh, wait...

name: Gobbsage String
description: This amulet is a fine souvenir of your battle with Gobbsage.

name: Gobbsage Breastplate
description: Don't be fooled by the softness of the wool, this breastplate will cut rocks like butter. It doesn't guarantee the safety of its wearer, however.

name: Zombo
description: It moves us with its underground beats and gets us our exercise. Given its irregular curves, it's only beneficial for the one carrying it.

name: The Zumbado
description: The Zombo is covered with splinters, so it's necessary to wear these gloves if you want to dance with it successfully.

name: Noxine
description: What could this strange mechanical creature be? In any case, it seems to be attracted to anything living. So cute!!!

name: Measured Tofu
description: Measured, like the choices you've made in evolving your Tofu. It looks like you've succeeded brilliantly!

name: Paunchy Tofu
description: Don't look now, but you may have been overfeeding your Tofu a bit…

name: Icky Tofu
description: Your Tofu was doomed to lifelong ickiness… once you became its owner!

name: Bontarian Tofu
description: This is one truly fine Tofu.

name: Charming Tofu
description: Your Tofu is a diva, and not the kind that sings, but a star just the same!

name: Brakmarian Tofu
description: Aggressive and irritable, your Tofu must have been seriously deprived of love when it was young.

name: Measured Bow Meow
description: Your Bow Meow has developed in a perfectly normal manner thanks to your disciplined supervision.

name: Paunchy Bow Meow
description: A Bow Meow this huge will be the butt of a thousand jokes. When this thing sits around the house… it really sits AROUND the house.

name: Icky Bow Meow
description: Your lack of attention to your Bow Meow's hygiene borders on criminal neglect. Shame on you.

name: Bontarian Bow Meow
description: Your Bow Meow is obedient and kind, thanks to the training you've given it.

name: Charming Bow Meow
description: Your Charming Bow Meow bows and meows most bewitchingly, making Bow Meowettes' hearts melt and lashes bat twitchingly.

name: Brakmarian Bow Meow
description: This is one seriously unapproachable Bow Meow. What a nasty piece of work!

name: Measured Boon
description: You've shown great skill in guiding your Boon's evolution.

name: Paunchy Boon
description: Safe to say that your Boon has never had to go hungry.

name: Icky Boon
description: It's not your fault if your Boon is allergic to cleanliness!

name: Bontarian Boon
description: Your Boon is always happy to see you, but don't leave it alone for a second.

name: Charming Boon
description: Who would have thought that a Boon could be so cute?

name: Brakmarian Boon
description: What a whiny but independent Boon. You'd swear you were looking at a Deuldeu.

name: Deluxe Mental Amulet
description: This amulet once belonged to a Huppermage who mastered the four primordial elemental energies. Apparently, fate (or Ogrest) played a trick on him.

properties.name: EXCLUSIVE_EQUIPMENT_ITEM
properties.description: Relic, only one item with this property can be equipped at a time

name: Amulet of Howlieng Wind
description: The Amulet of Howlieng Wind produces impressive energy in the presence of ambient winds and vapors. It is said that the power of its rotation is so strong that a curious Puddly could end up being scattered to the four corners of the World of Twelve if it came too close.

name: Young Drheller
description: This Young Drheller is such a joker that it will never stop looking for treasure for its master.

name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Boots
description: When your enemies see these boots, they'll feel like rats on a sinking ship.

properties.name: EXCLUSIVE_EQUIPMENT_ITEM
properties.description: Relic, only one item with this property can be equipped at a time

name: Ignemikhal Claws
description: These scorching-hot claws recall the blazing infernos created by their owner. Ignemikhal can be violent at times, and his fury now takes hold of you.

name: Ignemikhal Claws
description: These scorching-hot claws recall the blazing infernos created by their owner. Ignemikhal can be violent at times, and his fury now takes hold of you.

name: Aguabrial Scales
description: The original wearer of these scales was once charmed by Dathura. You'll experience the owner's calm even as you imagine the raging tempests he can unleash.

name: Aguabrial Scales

name: Beltrophy
description:
Its original owner was a remarkable fighter. A winner of numerous tournaments, he was an expert at recognizing his opponents' skills, and eventually joined forces with them to complement his own strengths. Reliable and always true to himself, his core principle was to always follow his convictions - an approach that brought him great success.
He was honest and pragmatic, and tough yet fair with his friends. He never hesitated to say what he was thinking without mincing his words. In an argument, it was better to be on his side if you didn't want to hear him saying "C'mon, seriously?!" every two sentences without even noticing it.

name: The Tock
description:
They say that this headgear once belonged to a robust Xelor who was deeply invested in his work. Though he was always ready to share a helpful tip and help his fellow Twelvians, many people didn't think much of his inventions, and audiences often shouted him down at his public appearances. 
He was totally inseparable from his Tick, and together they sometimes drove their friends crazy. It seems he even cut one of them loose completely after a nasty business involving a piece of farm equipment...

name: The Tick
description:
This cloak once belonged to an Eniripsa with a preposterously inflated image of herself. She genuinely thought she was the queen of Ecaflipus. Her sense of style, on the other hand, was anything but preposterous, and people all around the world were constantly seeking her favor.
She was totally inseparable from her Tock, and together they sometimes drove their friends crazy. Lots of people were jealous of her because she always had the best people around her, and wasn't afraid to say it. She was even a bit too talkative, in fact. You couldn't spend a day in Ecaflipus without hearing her gossiping with the local elites.

name: Shoulder Throws
description:
These epaulettes belongs to a courageous Feca known for his many charms. He seemed to have a new girlfriend every week, not to mention the countless young women he enchanted with his romantic letters.
He was also an extraordinary strategist who took down the greatest threats the world had ever faced, with the help of his traveling companions. His combative and competitive nature made him a fearsome opponent, as defeat was not an option for him. Legend has it that he even single-handedly bested some of the greatest arena fighters, and will always be remembered for having subjected one of the Wakfu era's greatest legends to a humiliating defeat in record time.

name: Indescribable Breastplate
description: It's an interesting experiment, trying to come up with a description for an indescribable item. Some would opt for the easy and economic solution of not describing the item at all. But we're better than that. If a wall of text must be written, so be it! Here we go. There's a lot that you can say about what it means to be indescribable. It could have several meanings. It might mean that we don't have the right words to describe the thing in question, because it's completely unprecedented, because it's unlike anything we've ever known, or maybe also because we don't have the lexical knowledge necessary to choose the right words that will best express the indescribable nature of the thing. So we hide all this uncertainty behind phrases like: "You see?! It's indescribable!", said with deep conviction. But is that really the end of the story? If we search deep inside, maybe an exact and appropriate description will reveal itself. Something sufficiently clear, and at the time sufficiently abstract to facilitate understanding of the described thing. If the words aren't sufficient, maybe it's necessary to invent new ones? Words coming from the heart. Words which speak for themselves when the limits of language have been reached. The indescribable, ultimately, is above all an unknown, which requires only that we put forth the effort to understand it, to let your imagination, your reason, and your feelings play in order to better understand and therefore find the words that could describe it. But that would be too much work for a simple breastplate description.

name: Tatsus Shushu
description:
Tatsu the Xelor was a fervent defender of law and justice. Everyone liked him and thought he was very nice, that is until he made a pact with a demon called Gor'fab. He developed exceptional skill at the guitar, but the Shushu came with a curse that prevented everyone from laughing at his practical jokes. Thus, Tatsu made many, many enemies. Many still remember him as a naughty troublemaker.
Luckily for him, a few friends remained loyal and managed to lift he curse temporarily. They exiled Gor'fab and his accomplice, Kaietan, far from the World of Twelve.
What followed are adventures that I, your devoted servant, dare not tell in full without risk. But the moral of the story is that justice can be subjective, and no one likes Tatsu's songs.

description:
A thick veil of mystery surrounds all that now remains of one of the most enigmatic creatures in the World of Twelve that spent years striding across Moon Island and Xelorium.
Some say that Kraive was a great warrior who took part in epic tournaments, both organizing them and competing in them. Others say she was a painter who painted indescribable works of art. One final theory, and by far the most surprising, is that she was a mere chair, nothing more nothing less.
All that we know for sure is that we sometimes hear a phrase echoing through Ecaflipus: "I want my forum title"...

Some have their muses, while other more pragmatic and scholarly people stick to their own methods. name: Ice Knight Sword
description:
The Ice Knight was famous for being one of the greatest sword smiths in all of Amakna. Only the horrible, pitiless Liche refused to recognize his immense talent. Offended that such a creature wouldn't stand in awe before his creations, he issued an ultimatum, refusing to forge so much as a teaspoon until his sword smith skills received the public recognition they deserved. But he hadn't reckoned on the horrible Liche, who never gave in.

A century or so later, the smith had to resign himself to going back to work... even though his skills had gotten rusty. This ridiculous sword was his last usable creation. The years passed by and the sword's true power was finally discovered. If shattered, the sword released an evil energy that would do lasting damage to Liche's economic activities. Mocked, provoked, humiliated, and beaten at her own game, she feigned giving up, only to come back meaner than ever and take her revenge when the time was right.

Then one day came Ogrest's Chaos. Forgotten myths and childish tall tales mingled at the dawn of this new world, and everyone had to adapt to this new cycle. Everyone except Liche, who was still plotting and planning her revenge.

She was finally defeated by a courageous whisperer, and she admitted in her final moments that she had never fully given in to hate. Unfairly isolated from the world by the jealous and the wicked, Liche found her daily joy in playing little jokes and tricks on friends and enemies alike. Far too few people ever took the time to learn more about her striking personality and extraordinary sense of friendship.

name: Koko's Boots
description:
The Krosmoz is vast. You realize it by looking at the millions of stars shining in the night sky... so many that you couldn't count them all in one lifetime. You realize it by imagining the wind blowing, a tireless force that swirls across the four corners of the World of Twelve, churning the oceans, tossing the dust, and piercing the clouds. You realize it by reading heroic tales about forgotten kingdoms and gods, by listening to tales of heroic deeds with mysterious plots, by touching the bones of long-extinct mystical creatures.

But you cannot better recognize the greatness of the universe than by measuring it against the most exceptional beings that live within it.

Maybe as you travel through the forests and mountains, the hiker's ramblings will lead you to memories of Koko, a brilliant, kind, concerned, and incredibly hard-working Brakmarian messenger. Maybe even as you wait for dawn to break over Ereboria Harbor, feeling the sea breeze on your face and hearing the sound of the waves on the dock, you will think you hear his distinctive laughter. Finally, maybe you will feel his judgmental gaze every time you utter some of your endless nonsense.

name: Zaza's Boots
description:
In the era that followed Ogrest's Chaos, there was a great Amaknian merchant by the name of Zaza. With the help of his loyal allies, he pushed back against the Amaknian ministries with wisdom and diplomacy to adopt fair and just laws for the people of the World of Twelve. His pricing policies were studied by economists. His goods were well-designed and long-lasting. His garments were silky smooth and a delight to wear. He will forever be considered one of the Wakfu Era's most beloved merchants.
One day, having established a climate of confidence and trust among the merchants of Amakna, he disappeared to seek out new adventure in Vulkania.
Some say he went there to pick strawberries, but no one ever went to Vulkania to check.

name: Lolzewolf's Necklace
description:
"Great goldsmith's work is unveiled,
Oftentimes goats follow the trail, 
And looking across the sky,
Tomorrow the end is nigh."

That is the inscription on this necklace. Brain-teaser or riddle? You can't say. Just like how you can't put into words the comforting feeling you get from this finely crafted necklace. It is the last legacy of a warrior with a golden heart and enhanced abilities. But you can also sense that despite his brilliant mind, this necklace's crafter experienced dark betrayals and unspeakable injustices.
The best adventurers in this world all have one thing in common: They're good at what they do. While the rest dream of being as good, they fail. Looking at this amulet one last time, you know it belonged to one of the very best.

Charon was always ahead of his time, so he ended up crafting an entire universe.

name: Armor of Trust
description:
Trust is a complex concept. Like a delicate flower, it needs a fertile soil of transparency, loyalty, and honesty to fully bloom. Some consider trust a valuable form of currency, to be invested in those who demonstrate their reliability over time. Others can be stingier, jealously guarding every morsel of trust like a well-hidden treasure.

It's interesting to see how certain stubborn souls will struggle to give their trust away, even to their closest friends. When dealing with such individuals, building trust can seem like navigating an emotional minefield, requiring great patience and understanding.

But in the delicate balance of trust and distrust, you just have to ignore them. Sticks and stones, as they say...

name: Zams's Buskins
description:
You can't deny the power of the spoken word. Zams knew this well, from her diminutive vantage point. That passion is what took her beyond words' use in simple day-to-day communication. She was especially attuned to music and the arts in general, and therein lay her unique power.

In her small village, Zams was known as an exceptional storyteller. She didn't need a booming voice, for her words alone captivated her audience. She knew how to imagine herself in the stories she told; beyond simply describing them, she experienced them vividly. Her words weren't merely heard, they were intensely felt by those listening.

Though her views could seem farfetched at times, the world will never forget her storytelling prowess. She had a unique way of imbuing words with emotion and making them resonate in others' hearts like no one else. Her words left an indelible mark on those who had the privilege to hear them.

From the bottomless well that is Twelvians' good nature, rises the wide frame of a contagiously good-natured cook.

Often admired for his explosive repartee, the ancestral mastery he demonstrated in his craft was truly staggering. It's said he made his weapons right in the kitchen, always accompanied by a loyal acolyte known only for her kindness.

name: Frrried Belt
description:
In the heart of the Krosmoz, among the billions of souls weaving the fabric of existence, a certain seagull with a taste for fried food and bamboo milk stands out.
Their shoulders, which bear the burden of their many missions, still stand proudly high, bearing witness to their solid commitment to dispelling any dark clouds over the skies of the World of Twelve.
They always approach events with seriousness, and even in the tensest situations, their thunderous laugh always ends up bursting out like a joyful symphony. Their laughter is so radiant that it lets those around them rise up and see past obstacles.
This brilliant ally will constantly watch your back, turning out to be much more than just a seagull in the heart of the Krosmoz. Their altruistic nature and sense of duty make them an invaluable ally at all times. These characteristics ensure a promising future for the World of Twelve, where this mysterious seagull's light will dispel the darkness and guide Twelvians toward bright things to come.

description:
The next time you have a fever, try this old Moogrr breeder's remedy, known as the "three-hat technique":
1) Place hat on bedside table
2) Lie down in bed
3) Drink some bamboo milk
4) Sip and repeat until you see three hats on the table
5) Fall asleep
The next day, you'll be cured!

Could it be a collective hallucination or a hidden message? It's up to you to find out.

name: The Cogs of Time
description: Destiny's path is set in stone. Time, on the other hand, is less stable. The laws governing the World of Twelve don't regulate it, except through Xelor's inscrutable sorcery. And so his followers created cogs, in order to achieve balance and stabilize the course of time. For most mortals, it's a simple mechanism used for one of the most abstract laws in the world. For followers of Xelor, it's a crucial step on the way to their destiny.

name: Toodles
description: Toodles is no ordinary belt. It can't be worn, and it moves on its own. It can hold four items of any kind that can help you at any point during your adventure, but it spends its time hiding from you. To get it to come to you, just shout, "OH TOODLES!" as loud as you can with your fellow adventurers. You'll hear the sound of a bell in response to your calling it, and the belt will be happy to give you the items you need. Ultimately, it's just a little machine that wants a bit of attention.

The clockmaker finally got it to work by combining several compasses in small compartments located completely at random. Reflexively, he named his original composition "Complication".

name: Split-Second Hands
description: How can you calculate the time interval between two actions? This question tormented the Clockmaker as he stared intently at his dials in search of a solution. Just as he was on the verge of inventing a new horological complication, he created two split-second hands. A small jolt makes them move to the next mark. It's a simple yet sufficient solution to calculate the time interval between a split-second hand and the second hand.

name: Figs Amulet
description:
Each day is a gentle reflection of the one before. Moving into the future involves keeping your eyes clearly focused on the past. Creating something new requires a re-examination of everything created previously.
That's what comes to mind when you pick up this positively skeuomorphic amulet. It was designed by artisans who took their inspiration from the Risky Ore Necklace and collected ridiculous quantities of that item for research purposes.
Its metaphorical stone is impressive, and the light playing gently upon its surface reveals all the wonders this necklace has to offer.
You intuitively sense that this is masterful work, but you're still not sure if the fighters should be shown on the timeline in relative or absolute terms.

name: Cloakinaut
description:
Papinaut was a brutal and merciless Sacrier who was unmatched when it came to destroying his enemies in a tempest of violence.
The same can't be said of Papinaut, the patient and mild-mannered Bonta mayor of the same name. That Papinaut made many key contributions to the World of Twelve's development with numerous revolutionary ideas and bold, courageous choices. Some of the firm stances he took earned him equally powerful reactions from the populace.
A third Papinaut also drew attention over the years. He was an eminent strategist and tactician who was always a few steps ahead. His one fault? He tended to talk a lot when people asked him questions. Perhaps it was an additional strategy to give his opponents no chance to speak...
Could all of them be the same person? If not, whose cloak was this really?

name: Tyra Ring
description:
Tyra was a highly effective merchant who was respected throughout Brakmar. Her marketing and trading techniques were quite original, combining an occasionally crude sense of humor with impressive expertise about her products.
Sadly, she was also known for selling pricing information to a brotherhood of nasty Trools. Their most brutish member, known as Gablaut, quickly sold her tips on to the highest bidder... a dangerous game that landed the merchant behind bars.
Tyra didn't spend the rest of her days in prison, however. She used one of her patented tricks to incapacitate the guards, then left to enjoy her well-deserved retirement on the warm sands of Bilbiza.
No one knows exactly what became of Gablaut, but one story has it that he regretted betraying his informant and desperately searched for her for years before they finally made peace.

name: Kris Breastplate
description:
This is the story of a passionate merchant named Kris. He started from nothing but achieved great success through his tireless hard work. He was always there to support his friends and suggest original ideas to sell new products.
It's said he liked to get together with a few friends at a tavern after a long, hard day on the job. There he'd play a nice board game or two, or perhaps he'd fire up the Bilbidecks to play a bit of music, like David Ghetto.
After every performance, an awed silence would fall over the tavern... A silence that was inevitably broken by the gobbling of the turkey at the farm next door.

name: Naelin Ring
description:
Naelin was a Feca adventurer with an insatiable thirst for history and discovery. Her scholarship was every bit as impressive as that of Fecaline the Wise. Some even said she exceeded Magus Ax in that department! 

Her legendary Frigostian equipment gave her a disturbingly icy aura, sometimes leading strangers to assume she was cold and distant. But nothing could have been further from the truth! She never took it off, despite her fellow adventurers' pleas to change her gear at some point.

They knew better than anyone that this Feca was the glue that held them all together. Through her kindness, wisdom, and unifying spirit, Naelin always made sure that their adventures ended well. And for that, they will always be grateful to her.

name: Riebeck Boots
description:
These terrifically uncomfortable boots belonged to Riebeck, a meticulous Foggernaut who never left anything to chance. When his friends asked him why he chose to endure such discomfort, he simply replied, "To be sure I never end up shaking in my boots."
That's Riebeck for you: Every problem had a solution, and preferably a simple and straightforward one! A brilliant handyman, he had an unparalleled knack for helping others to clarify their own ideas and make them a reality.
His workshop was known for being an incredible mess. Convinced that everything had some hidden use, the Foggernaut obstinately refused to ever throw anything away. If you pointed out that one of his tools was falling apart, he'd invariably reply, "Why throw it out? It still works just fine!" while calmly sipping his oolong tea. What a character!

description: There's a friend out there for all of us in this big wide world. Sometimes they're right in front of our eyes, or sometimes blending into the background. Sometimes, they've gone far away. Sometimes a dispute comes between us, possibly forever. But through it all, a friend is still a friend: an undefinable but important presence.

name: Akro Belt
description:
Akro the Eliatrope undertook a long journey of purification to the very limits of the Krosmoz. Each step along that path led him into new worlds where he experienced extraordinary things: fountains so high that the droplets flooded the horizon, suns of various shapes shining a captivating light on the leaves of indescribable trees, and caves so deep and wide that all the kamas in Bonta wouldn't fill them.
With an eye to the future, he restructured these worlds with great care, adding something unique and sustainable for future generations.
No one ever knew what this solitary hero's ultimate goal was: to save the princess, restore balance in the Krosmoz, perhaps to find someone...?
Nor did anyone know how long his journey lasted.
All that history remembers is that wherever he went, he was welcomed warmly by people who appreciated him greatly.

name: Richard's Spectacles
description: Courage is a virtue few people can boast about. Richard is the exact opposite. This young Feca, who is afraid of everything and nothing at all, studies statistics for the sole purpose of calculating the risk factors in his daily life. This is to prevent him from getting so much as a scrape on his arm or a boo-boo on his knee. Strangely enough, he disappeared into a library in Amakna, leaving behind only a few books and his spectacles. Their covers read "Horror", "Adventure", and "Daring". Odd choices, but they'd make even the most fearful tofu brave!

name: Wyze Epaulettes
description:
Wyze, an Enutrof in the Dofus Era, made his fortune in the Kwak feather trade.
He worked so much and so well that many of his fellow merchants were quite jealous of him.
Wyze's naturally sunny and affable disposition led him into lots of unfortunate misadventures with those who would take advantage of the Enutrof's legendary generosity. But rather than getting angry with them, Wyze focused on his real treasures: his closest friends.
He liked to gather with them at secret meetings in a Sufokian inn known as Chanco Bailo after a rousing match of beach gobbowl. It wasn't uncommon for Wyze to offer lovingly handcrafted plushies to his friends, who had become like siblings to him.
Their weekly get-togethers always gave the Enutrof a refreshing shot of enthusiasm, vigor, and strength. Just for a night, his youth was restored (though his hair never was).

name: Angy Epaulettes
description:
This soft pair of epaulettes seems to have been crafted with exceptional care. They're very easy to equip and unequip, and reaching the various buttons is very natural and intuitive. They're truly perfect in every way, from their "look and feel" to their ability to collapse for storage!
Under the armor, you'll find some engraved texts referring to a "mockup". How can it be that such a practical, good-looking pair of epaulettes isn't even the final version?
That's the kind of work you can expect from Angy, an extraordinary blacksmith who continuously improved her work based on feedback from her users.
Calm, cultivated, and always ready to help others with a smile, she also had a unique talent for partying, and for organizing unique and high-spirited quizzes.

name: Reiem Ring
description:
This dark ring was forged by a great Shushu by the name of Reiem. Exiled by Rushu for the heinous and reprehensible crime of having organized an illegal chess game, the demon would wander the Shustuft Crust for centuries thereafter.
Reiem met many devils on his path of exile, until one day he found a passage to the World of Twelve. His daily shushued ping-pong training had given him such extraordinary muscles that he could lift a huge boulder with no effort... and beneath it was a one-way tunnel to Brakmar.
For a time, he returned to a simple life there. Yet his hair care routine was so meticulous, and his mane so soft and shiny, that he soon became a model for Laurie Al, the famous Brakmarian perfume maker. He now lives a happy life, but he has carefully held on to this ring as a memory of his years in hell.

name: Swordaigo
description:
This sword weighs heavily in your hands. Well, it is full of good ideas, delicacy, and potential. Yes, and it can also slice cleanly through any opponent.
These are the two sides to the Swordaigo, which is sheathed on both shoulders at the same time when you grasp the hilt.
On your left, you see a Bontarian whispering to you to mercilessly decapitate the Brakmarian scum.
On your right, there is a Brakmarian giving you ideas related to capybaras.

name: Armadastunner
description:
"What a cool club!"
That's how people tend to talk about this terrifying bludgeon. It was used to smash a great many monsters, including Tal Kasha, who was reduced to dust after getting hit again and again. But what's this club's real strength? You can use it to bash in other adventurers' heads. And this bludgeon has seen its fair share of adventurers buckle beneath it.
Other than that, it's still pretty cool.

name: Zeemass
description:
This is the tale of a Xelor renowned, whose backside happens to be quite round.
His friends can't keep him on the ground, when his enemies in the area abound.
Always seeking to earn a pound, thanks to his drive does his progress astound.
This fire Xelor to undo his gains is often bound, as to him starting over is perfectly sound.

Player, trainer, and even supervisor, Zimas is a most dependable leader.
Whether crossing the world faster or slower, he trains great heroes to be even better.
This Xelor, 500 million kamas in error, took a seat after encountering more than one liar.
Blessed with tact and memory that stoke fear, in the rankings Zimas is certainly premier.

name: Kaid'O Scale
description:
This scale belonged to Kaïdo, a famed warrior who could never be defeated and a tamer of white-eyed blue dragons. With such a resistant shield, you'll have a hard time losing HP. If you carry it, only a being of divine power will be able to inflict damage on you...
As for Kaïdo, no one knows what became of him. Legend has it he no longer needed a shield to protect himself, which wouldn't be a surprise, given his skill in combat - even Magmog was no match for him.

name: Nozadahgue
description: On the hilt of this dagger, you can just barely make out an inscription: "Moogrr Dungeon". Yet another line about Moogrrs may not be funny anymore, but these references are still inextricable from the exceptional adventurer who created the Nozadahgue. This patient, curious, methodical, and calculating fan of the World of Twelve lived through many periods, taking special care to spread knowledge and bringing together those uninitiated in theorycrafting under his tutelage.

name: Nozadahgue
description: On the hilt of this dagger, you can just barely make out an inscription: "I never farmed Moogrr Dungeon". Yet another line about Moogrrs may not be funny anymore, but these references are still inextricable from the exceptional adventurer who created the Nozadahgue. This patient, curious, methodical, and calculating fan lived through many periods of the World of Twelve, taking special care to spread knowledge and bringing together those uninitiated in theorycrafting under his tutelage.
